items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary user experience study with a small sample size (n=6) and lacks a control group, preventing assessment of definitive clinical efficacy.

items.title: Use of Rehabilitation Therapy Services among World Trade Center Health Program Members with Cancer
items.summary: This study aims to examine the utilization of rehabilitation therapy services among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer certification between 2011 and 2024.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究（2011-2024 年数据）揭示了世贸中心健康计划中癌症患者康复服务的使用模式。它提示了特定高危人群在康复服务可及性和利用上的潜在缺口，值得我们作为政策制定者和康复服务提供者深入评估。
items.titleZh: 世贸中心健康计划癌症患者康复治疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在调查 2011 年至 2024 年间，世贸中心健康计划中患有癌症的成员对康复治疗服务的利用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study (2011-2024 data) illuminates rehabilitation service utilization patterns among cancer patients in the World Trade Center Health Program. It signals potential gaps in accessibility and uptake for this specific high-risk population, warranting deeper evaluation from policymakers and rehabilitation providers like us.
items.limitation: 尚无摘要或全文，无法评估研究设计细节，可能存在因数据来源和人群特异性导致的局限。
items.limitationEn: No abstract or full text is available to assess study design details; limitations may exist due to data source and population specificity.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation
items.summary: This mixed-methods study investigates factors associated with pediatric rehabilitation service initiation through an integrated analysis of sociodemographic characteristics and parental experiences of non-initiation.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究深入剖析了影响儿科康复服务启动的社会人口学因素及家长经验，提醒我们很多家庭在康复服务初期会遇到障碍。作为儿科物理治疗师，我们可以此为鉴，审视并优化转诊和服务流程，以提高服务依从性。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过对社会人口学特征和家长未启动服务经历的综合分析，调查了与儿科康复服务启动相关的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study delves into sociodemographic factors and parental experiences influencing the initiation of pediatric rehabilitation services, highlighting common barriers families face. As pediatric physical therapists, we should leverage these insights to review and optimize our referral and service processes to improve adherence.
items.limitation: 尚无摘要或全文，无法评估研究设计细节，可能存在方法学或外推性方面的局限。
items.limitationEn: No abstract or full text is available to assess study design details; limitations may exist in methodology or generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: CMS Extends and Modifies Nationwide Freeze on New Medicare Hospice and Home Health Enrollment for Six Months to Combat Fraud
items.summary: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for an additional six months to combat fraud.
items.curatedReason: CMS 将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月。如果你在考虑开设新的安宁疗护或家庭健康服务，这表明美国监管环境收紧，短期内机会窗口关闭，需要密切关注后续政策走向。
items.titleZh: CMS 延长并修改全国范围内对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结六个月，以打击欺诈行为
items.summaryZh: CMS 已将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月，以打击欺诈行为。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for six months. If you are considering opening new hospice or home health services, this indicates a tightening regulatory environment in the U.S. and a closed window of opportunity in the short term. You should closely monitor future policy developments.

items.title:
XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 24 studies found that XR serious games demonstrated preliminary benefits in reducing phantom limb pain (largest effect sizes with AR-based phantom motor execution systems, d = 0.9–1.3), improving functional mobility, and supporting prosthesis adoption after amputation.
items.curatedReason: XR 严肃游戏，特别是 AR 幻肢运动执行系统（d = 0.9–1.3），有望作为截肢术后幻肢痛管理、功能活动度提升和假肢适应的新辅助手段。虽然这只是初步证据，但其在疼痛干预和假肢使用训练方面的潜力值得我们关注。
items.titleZh: 用于幻肢痛、神经功能恢复和假肢采纳的扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 24 项研究的系统综述发现，扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛（AR 幻肢运动执行系统效应量最大，d=0.9-1.3）、改善截肢后的功能活动能力和支持假肢采纳方面显示出初步益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: XR serious games, especially AR-based phantom motor execution systems (d = 0.9–1.3), show promise as an adjunct for managing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, and aiding prosthesis adoption post-amputation. While preliminary, this evidence warrants attention for its potential in pain intervention and prosthetic training.
items.limitation: 神经功能和具身性结局的证据仍处于探索阶段，XR游戏的实际应用和可扩展性仍有待深入研究。
items.limitationEn: The evidence for neurofunctional and embodiment outcomes is still exploratory, and real-world implementation and scalability of XR games remain under-researched.

items.title: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summary: A non-randomized prospective cohort study found that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy led to lower postoperative complication rates (P=0.043), shorter hospital stays (7.1 vs. 10.5 days), and improved functional recovery (6-minute walk test) compared to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，针对虚弱老年胃切除术患者的多学科 ERAS 干预能显著降低术后并发症率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 对 10.5 天）并改善功能恢复。对这类脆弱人群，整合性、团队协作的围手术期护理是值得推广的策略。
items.titleZh: ERAS理念下多学科干预对进行胃切除术的衰弱老年患者预后的影响：一项非随机前瞻性队列研究
items.titleEn: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summaryZh: 一项针对接受胃切除术的衰弱老年患者的非随机前瞻性队列研究发现，基于ERAS的多学科干预可降低术后并发症发生率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 vs. 10.5天），并改善功能恢复，优于常规护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention can significantly improve outcomes for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy, including reduced complications and hospital stay. This supports the integration of comprehensive, team-based perioperative care for this vulnerable population.
items.limitation: 本研究采用非随机化设计与历史对照，且30天再入院率差异无统计学意义。
items.limitationEn: The study used a non-randomized design with historical controls, and the 30-day readmission rate difference was not statistically significant.

items.title: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summary: This commentary discusses blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a low-load resistance exercise strategy that achieves strength gains comparable to high-load training, suggesting its utility for patients with COPD and other conditions, enabling exercise from clinic to home.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论强调，血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力运动策略，能达到与高负荷训练相当的力量增益。对于 COPD 及其他不耐受高负荷训练的患者，BFR 有望成为一种从诊所到家庭都可实行的有效方案，值得临床同行进一步关注。
items.titleZh: “少即是多”：从诊所到居家，COPD及其他疾病的血流限制训练
items.titleEn: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summaryZh: 本文评述了血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力训练策略，可实现与高负荷训练相当的力量增益，并提出其在COPD等疾病患者中的应用前景，支持从诊所到居家进行训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a promising low-load resistance training method that can elicit strength gains comparable to high-load training. Its application in populations intolerant to high loads, such as those with COPD, from clinic to home, warrants further clinical attention.

items.title: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review of 43 studies found acute hypoxic exposure generally does not decrease Wingate test performance unless severe (FiO2 ~0.104) or repeated; prolonged chronic exposure can reduce performance, but shorter camps do not. Intermittent hypoxic training likely benefits performance when combined with longer exercise durations.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述指出，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非缺氧程度严重 (FiO2 ~0.104) 或反复暴露；长期慢性缺氧可能会降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性低氧训练在结合更长运动持续时间时，很可能有利于提高表现。
items.titleZh: 缺氧暴露和训练方法对 Wingate 测试表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 43 项研究的系统综述发现，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非在严重（FiO2 ~0.104）或重复情况下；长期慢性暴露可能降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性缺氧训练可能在与较长运动时间结合时有益于表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that acute hypoxic exposure does not significantly impair Wingate test performance unless severe or repeated, and prolonged chronic exposure may reduce anaerobic performance. Intermittent hypoxic training, especially with longer exercise durations, may enhance anaerobic capacity.
items.limitation: 该综述发现，高强度间歇训练可能会提高无氧运动表现，无论是否缺氧，这表明训练方式本身是关键。
items.limitationEn: The review found that high-intensity interval training may improve anaerobic performance regardless of hypoxic exposure, suggesting the modality itself is key.

items.title: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summary: An exploratory case-crossover study in professional women's football found that injury seasons had slightly greater match exposure (minutes, appearances) and estimated travel distance in the 30 days prior to injury compared to matched control periods, though effect sizes were small and variability was high.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提出，在职业女子足球中，受伤前 30 天的比赛暴露（上场时间、出场次数）和预估旅行距离可能略有增加。尽管效应量小且变异性大，这些发现可为未来前瞻性研究的 ACL 损伤预防策略提供思路。
items.titleZh: 职业女子足球运动员 ACL 损伤前的比赛暴露与预估行程：一项探索性个体交叉研究
items.titleEn: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summaryZh: 一项对职业女子足球运动员的探索性个体交叉研究发现，与匹配的对照期相比，ACL 损伤赛季前的比赛暴露（分钟数、出场次数）和 30 天内的预估行程稍多，但效应量小且变异性大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests that slightly higher match exposure and travel distance may precede ACL injuries in professional women’s football. While effect sizes are small and variability is high, these findings could inform future prospective research on injury prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性研究，效应量小，玩家间变异性大，且未建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study is exploratory with small effect sizes and substantial between-player variability, and it does not establish causality.

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study of 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found only a 42.7% service initiation rate, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, communication, and financial challenges, varying by patient characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究揭示了儿童康复服务依从性低（仅 42.7%）背后的复杂障碍，包括地理可及性、排班困难、费用、交通以及专业人员与家庭沟通不畅等。应关注这些因素，以提高服务启动率并减少社会人口学差异。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究显示，服务启动率仅为 42.7%，障碍包括地域可及性、排班、沟通和财务挑战，并因患者特征而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study reveals complex barriers behind low pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates (only 42.7%), including geographic availability, scheduling difficulties, cost, transportation, and poor communication between professionals and families. Addressing these factors is crucial for improving service initiation and reducing sociodemographic disparities.
items.limitation: 这项研究来自单一的儿科医疗机构，其结果可能存在地域性和系统性局限，不一定能完全推广至其他医疗系统或更广泛的地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within a single pediatric healthcare organization, and its findings may have geographic and systemic limitations, potentially not fully generalizable to other healthcare systems or broader regions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for an RCT (n=36) to evaluate the added effect of an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome, focusing on postural angles as the primary outcome over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对“上交叉综合征”的随机对照试验方案，旨在验证个体化、分阶段的矫正运动方案的附加效果。该方案尝试标准化入组标准和干预内容，有助于提高研究可重复性。对肩颈姿势问题感兴趣的临床医师可以关注其后续研究结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的个体化系统矫正运动：一项随机对照试验方案。
items.summaryZh: 这是一项针对 36 名符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的随机对照试验方案，旨在评估个体化、系统知情矫正运动方案的附加效果，主要结局指标是 12 周后的姿势角度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an RCT on "upper crossed syndrome," aiming to validate the additive effect of individualized, staged corrective exercise. The protocol standardizes eligibility and interventions, which should improve reproducibility. Clinicians interested in shoulder-neck posture issues may follow its future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据，且其 4 周的随访期无法提供关于复发预防的长期推论。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol without actual results yet, and its 4-week follow-up period will not support long-term inferences about recurrence prevention.

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis (n=56) of children with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life (median PedsQL 72.3/100.0), but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0). Unilateral lower limb loss was associated with superior adjustment and prosthetic satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 大地震两年后，儿童截肢者的肢体功能、社会功能和学校相关生活质量表现良好，但情感健康仍受影响，提示康复服务应整合长期心理健康支持。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震两年后肢体缺失儿童的身体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 56 名地震相关肢体缺失儿童的回顾性分析显示，截肢 2.3 年后，其身体、社会和学校相关生活质量良好（PedsQL 中位数 72.3/100.0），但情感功能较低（60.0/100.0）。单侧下肢缺失的儿童表现出更好的适应性和假肢满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years post-earthquake, children with limb loss showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remained affected. This highlights the need for integrated long-term mental health support within rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，样本来自单一康复中心，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective analysis with samples from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias and data completeness limitations.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational study found that the Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, though no single test was sufficiently strong alone. Combining tests with fall history (AUC 0.89-0.97) improved model fit.
items.curatedReason: TUG 和 FSST 在预测老年人跌倒风险方面表现出最高的区分度，但单一测试的效能不足以独立预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合使用可提高预测准确性。
items.titleZh: 功能性活动能力测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效用
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究发现，计时起立行走测试（TUG，AUC=0.777）和四方步进测试（FSST，AUC=0.771）在预测老年人跌倒方面具有最高的区分度，但单一测试不足以可靠预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合（AUC 0.89-0.97）可提高模型拟合度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TUG and FSST showed the highest discrimination for fall risk in older adults, but individual tests were insufficient for standalone prediction. Combining functional tests with fall history improved predictive accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性队列研究，样本量相对较小，且功能测试与跌倒史结合的发现需外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational cohort study with a relatively small sample size, and the findings regarding combining functional tests with fall history require external validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: CMS Posts Bidder Licensure Guide for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program & Updates to HCPCS Level II Code Classifications for Certain Leg and Arm Braces | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program
items.summary: CMS has posted the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, effective December 1, 2026, reclassifying L1833, L1851, L1852, and L3761 from off-the-shelf to requiring professional fitting.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目（CBP）的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，明确这些矫形器不再符合“现成”定义，需要由专业人员适配。这直接影响DMEPOS供应商的投标策略和PT/OT执业者选择和报销相关矫形器的实践。
items.titleZh: CMS发布2028年DMEPOS竞标项目投标者执照指南并更新部分腿臂矫形器HCPCS Level II编码分类
items.summaryZh: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，自2026年12月1日起，将L1833、L1851、L1852和L3761从“现成”重新分类为需专业人员适配。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program (CBP) and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, clarifying that these braces no longer meet the “off-the-shelf” definition and require fitting by a qualified professional. This directly impacts DMEPOS suppliers' bidding strategies and the practice of PT/OT professionals in selecting and billing for these braces.

items.title: Comparison of Radiofrequency Microtenotomy vs. Heavy-Slow Resistance for Refractory Plantar Fasciopathy: A Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=72) found no significant difference in FHSQ-DK pain domain mean change from baseline to 6 months between radiofrequency microtenotomy and heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy (mean difference −4.9, 95% CI −13.8; 4.0).
items.curatedReason: 对于顽固性足底筋膜病，这项RCT明确指出射频微切开术并不优于重慢速抗阻训练。这意味着对这类患者，运动疗法应作为首选干预，避免不必要的微创手术。
items.titleZh: 射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练治疗顽固性足底筋膜病的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=72）显示，对于顽固性足底筋膜病，射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练在6个月时FHSQ-DK疼痛域的平均变化无显著差异（平均差−4.9，95% CI −13.8; 4.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For refractory plantar fasciopathy, this RCT clearly indicates that radiofrequency microtenotomy is not superior to heavy-slow resistance training. This suggests that exercise therapy should be the preferred intervention for these patients, avoiding unnecessary minimally invasive surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究的随访时间为6个月，未能评估长期疗效；且部分患者退出可能影响了最终分析的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was 6 months, not allowing for long-term efficacy assessment, and patient dropouts may have affected the precision of the final analysis.

items.title: Radiographic quantification of active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises and its potential prognostic value in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
items.summary: A prospective study (n=not specified) found that active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises (PSSE) resulted in 27.32% Cobb angle correction (from 37.57° to 28.82°) and was the only variable significantly associated with 6-month post-treatment Cobb angle change.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究首次放射学量化了特发性脊柱侧凸患者在PSSE训练中的主动自我矫正（ASC）程度，并发现其与6个月后的Cobb角变化相关。这提示在临床中评估患者的自我矫正能力，可能有助于预测治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动中主动自我矫正的影像学量化及其在青少年特发性脊柱侧凸中的潜在预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性研究（n=未注明）发现，物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动（PSSE）中的主动自我矫正可使Cobb角矫正27.32%（从37.57°至28.82°），且是唯一与6个月治疗后Cobb角变化显著相关的变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study for the first time radiographically quantified active self-correction (ASC) during PSSE in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and found it correlated with Cobb angle change at 6 months. This suggests that assessing patients' self-correction ability in practice may help predict treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小，且随访期为6个月，尚不能完全评估长期预后价值。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and the 6-month follow-up period is insufficient to fully assess long-term prognostic value.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: Integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improved early postoperative LEFS at 4 weeks (+1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02 to 3.07, P = 0.047) in 128 patients, but this advantage diminished by week 12.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全膝关节置换术后常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，在早期（术后4周）对LEFS评分有小幅改善，但临床意义不明显，且优势不持久。在改变常规实践前，需要更强的证据和更长的随访。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对128名全膝关节置换术后患者的随机对照试验发现，在常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，可在术后4周适度改善下肢功能量表（LEFS）评分（+1.55分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P = 0.047），但此优势在12周时减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding hip-ankle training to conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improves early postoperative LEFS scores at 4 weeks, but the clinical significance is limited and the benefit is not sustained. Stronger evidence and longer follow-up are needed before altering routine practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，随访时间相对较短（12周），且主要结局的临床重要性阈值未明确达到。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a relatively short follow-up (12 weeks), and the clinical importance threshold for the primary outcome was not clearly met.

items.title: GLIM-defined malnutrition and frailty in older outpatients with diabetes
items.summary: Among 391 older outpatients with diabetes, GLIM-defined malnutrition was prevalent in 33% and independently associated with frailty (OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007), according to a retrospective study.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示，在患有糖尿病的老年门诊患者中，GLIM标准定义的营养不良非常普遍（33%），且与衰弱独立相关。这提示你在对老年糖尿病患者进行综合老年评估时，应高度关注营养不良和衰弱的筛查与管理，以支持更个体化的临床干预。
items.titleZh: GLIM定义的营养不良与糖尿病老年门诊患者的衰弱
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究显示，在391名糖尿病老年门诊患者中，33%存在GLIM定义的营养不良，且营养不良与衰弱独立相关（OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that GLIM-defined malnutrition is highly prevalent (33%) and independently associated with frailty in older outpatients with diabetes. This suggests that when conducting comprehensive geriatric assessments for older diabetic patients, you should prioritize screening and managing malnutrition and frailty to support more individualized clinical interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, which cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: In a 6-month prospective cohort study of 112 stroke patients, stride time variability (STV) at discharge, with an optimal cutoff of 3.40% (AUC 0.756, sensitivity 88.2%, specificity 53.8%), was identified as the sole independent predictor of post-discharge falls, outperforming conventional measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，卒中患者出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV）是预测其出院后6个月内跌倒风险的独立指标，其3.40%的截断值可辅助早期风险识别。这提示你在临床实践中应常规评估STV，并对高风险患者实施有针对性的跌倒预防干预。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险预测指标：一项6个月随访的队列研究和生存分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对112名卒中患者进行6个月随访的前瞻性队列研究显示，出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV），以3.40%为最佳截断值（AUC 0.756，敏感性88.2%，特异性53.8%），是出院后跌倒的唯一独立预测因子，优于其他常规测量指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study indicates that stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of fall risk within 6 months post-discharge for stroke patients, with a 3.40% cutoff value aiding early risk identification. This suggests you should routinely assess STV in clinical practice and implement targeted fall prevention interventions for high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心样本，可能限制了STV截断值的普适性，需要多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's single-center sample may limit the generalizability of the STV cutoff value, requiring multi-center validation.

items.title: Validation of Video-based Motion Capture for Lower Body and Trunk Kinematics with Marker Augmentation
items.summary: A study validated video-based motion capture with marker augmentation for lower body and trunk kinematics, suggesting its potential as a low-cost, non-invasive tool for movement analysis.
items.curatedReason: 视频捕捉技术结合标记物增强，在下肢和躯干运动学评估中显示出准确性，这提示我们，低成本、非侵入性的运动分析工具可能很快就能进入临床。在考虑购置昂贵设备前，不妨关注这类技术的成熟度。
items.titleZh: 带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学中的验证
items.summaryZh: 一项研究验证了带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学分析中的准确性，提示了其作为低成本、非侵入性运动分析工具的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Video-based motion capture with marker augmentation shows promise for accurate lower body and trunk kinematics. This suggests low-cost, non-invasive movement analysis tools might soon be viable for clinical use. Before investing in expensive equipment, keep an eye on how these technologies mature.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于可能仅在特定实验室条件下进行验证，其在真实临床环境中的普适性和操作便捷性仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is that validation may have been conducted only under specific laboratory conditions, and its generalizability and operational convenience in real clinical settings still require further evaluation.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Ultrasound-guided versus landmark-guided injections in musculoskeletal practice: a scoping review of clinical efficacy, educational needs, and economic considerations
items.summary: A scoping review of 29 studies found ultrasound-guided (US) injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may provide short-term symptomatic benefit at selected sites (shoulder, knee, elbow). However, comparative clinical superiority at longer follow-up and cost-effectiveness remain undetermined.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述表明，超声引导注射可可靠提高注射准确性，并在特定部位提供短期症状缓解，但长期临床优越性和成本效益尚无定论。它提醒你，在将超声引导注射常规化之前，仍需权衡患者解剖特点、临床需求和经济因素。
items.titleZh: 超声引导与体表标志引导注射在肌肉骨骼实践中的对比：临床疗效、教育需求和经济考量范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 29 项研究的范围综述发现，超声引导（US）注射可可靠地提高置入准确性，并在选定部位（肩、膝、肘）提供短期症状改善。然而，在较长随访期内的比较临床优越性和成本效益仍未确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that ultrasound-guided injections reliably improve placement accuracy and may offer short-term symptomatic relief at selected sites, but long-term clinical superiority and cost-effectiveness are not established. It reminds you to weigh patient anatomy, clinical requirements, and economic considerations before routinely adopting ultrasound-guided injections.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性高，且缺乏统一的经济学分析模型，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: High methodological heterogeneity among included studies and a lack of uniform economic analysis models limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Integrated Decision-Making Under Uncertainty in High-Performance Sport Support Systems
items.summary: A narrative review proposes a framework for integrated decision-making in high-performance sport support systems, combining established decision principles with qualitative triage. It outlines five interdependent functions for integrated work and emphasizes athlete values, decision rights, and coaches' roles.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为高水平运动支持系统中的决策制定提供了一个框架，强调了在不确定性下整合证据和专业判断的重要性。它能帮助你优化你的跨学科协作方式，更好地将科学推理应用于运动员的康复与表现管理。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动支持系统中不确定性下的整合决策 | 运动医学 - 开放
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述提出了一种高水平运动支持系统中整合决策的框架，结合了既定的决策原则和定性分类。它概述了整合工作的五个相互依赖的功能，并强调了运动员价值观、决策权和教练角色的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In high-performance sport support systems, you need to integrate established decision principles with qualitative triage, rather than relying on a single model. The framework provided by this review can help you optimize interdisciplinary collaboration and better integrate evidence with professional judgment under uncertainty.
items.limitation: 该框架仍是概念性的，其内容效度、可用性、分类一致性、实施负担和决策过程仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The framework remains conceptual, and its content validity, usability, triage consistency, implementation burden, and decision processes require further evaluation.

items.title: Routine physical function assessment may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis
items.summary: A commentary on a nested case-control study (Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062) suggests that routine assessment of gait speed, grip strength, and frailty may identify older adults at increased risk of dementia years before diagnosis, advocating for their inclusion in longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 日常体能评估（如步速、握力和衰弱程度）不仅关乎身体健康，也可能预示认知功能。这项述评提示你，将这些评估纳入对老年人的常规监测，有望在痴呆诊断前数年识别高风险个体，为早期干预或延缓认知衰退争取时间。
items.titleZh: 常规身体功能评估或可在痴呆诊断前数年识别患病风险增加的老年人
items.summaryZh: 一项对巢式病例对照研究（Age Ageing 2026;55(4):afag062）的述评指出，常规评估步速、握力和衰弱程度可能在痴呆诊断前数年识别出患病风险增加的老年人，并倡导将其纳入长期监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Routine physical function assessments (e.g., gait speed, grip strength, and frailty) are not only about physical health but may also predict cognitive function. This commentary suggests incorporating these assessments into routine monitoring of older adults, potentially identifying high-risk individuals years before a dementia diagnosis, allowing time for early intervention or delaying cognitive decline.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于对现有证据的解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary rather than an original research study, so its conclusions are based on an interpretation of existing evidence.

items.title:
Stakeholder priorities for rehabilitation to support functioning at home and work among people on sick leave due to low back pain: a group concept mapping study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A group concept mapping study (n=101) identified six stakeholder-prioritized clusters for low back pain rehabilitation for people on sick leave: self-management, physical training, workplace involvement, interdisciplinary coordination, individual support, and extended assessment. All clusters received high importance ratings.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究清晰地界定了因腰痛病假人群对康复的优先需求，涵盖了自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与等六大集群。它强调了以患者为中心、跨部门协调的康复模式，能够指导你优化对这类患者的综合康复策略，促进他们重返家庭和工作。
items.titleZh: 因腰痛请病假人群的康复利益相关者优先事项，以支持居家和工作功能：一项团体概念图研究
items.summaryZh: 一项团体概念图研究（n=101）确定了因腰痛请病假人群的六个利益相关者优先康复集群：自我管理、体能训练、工作场所参与、跨学科协调、个体支持和扩展评估。所有集群均获得高度重要性评价。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study clearly defines the rehabilitation priorities for people on sick leave due to low back pain, covering six clusters including self-management, physical training, and workplace involvement. It emphasizes patient-centered, cross-sectoral coordinated rehabilitation models, which can guide you in optimizing comprehensive rehabilitation strategies for these patients, promoting their return to home and work.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且参与者仅来自丹麦，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, and participants were only from Denmark, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted assessment of the forward roll in the Fundamental Motor Skills in Sport (FUS) test: agreement with expert consensus, inter-rater reliability, and rater workload
items.summary: An AI system showed substantial to almost perfect agreement with expert consensus (kappa 0.73–0.85; quadratic weighted kappa 0.95) for assessing forward rolls in children's motor skills. Human ratings with AI support more closely matched expert consensus (mean absolute error 0.68 vs 0.99) and raters reported less effort.
items.curatedReason: AI 辅助评估在儿童基础运动技能测试中展现出与专家高度一致的潜力。在儿科康复领域，这预示着未来 AI 有望成为评估工具，减轻评估者负担，提升评估标准化与可靠性。
items.titleZh: 人工智能辅助评估儿童运动技能测试中的前滚翻：与专家共识的一致性、评分者间可靠性和评分者工作量
items.summaryZh: 一项研究显示，在评估儿童前滚翻运动技能时，AI 系统与专家共识具有高度一致性（kappa 0.73–0.85；加权kappa 0.95）。AI 辅助下的人工评分与专家共识更接近（平均绝对误差 0.68 vs 0.99），且评分者报告工作量减少。
items.curatedReasonEn: AI-assisted assessment shows high potential for agreement with expert consensus in children's fundamental motor skills tests. In pediatric rehabilitation, this suggests AI could become a valuable assessment tool, reducing assessor workload and improving standardization and reliability.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为硕士生评估者，且评估条件标准化，结论外推至实践教师或其他年龄组需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved only master's students as raters under standardized video conditions, limiting generalizability to practicing teachers or other age groups.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Changes in cervical muscle mechanical properties during orofacial motor tasks in individuals with and without chronic neck pain
items.summary: In 84 adults, orofacial motor tasks significantly altered cervical muscle mechanical properties (e.g., frequency, stiffness, relaxation time, creep) in sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles, regardless of chronic neck pain status. While the neck pain group showed lower absolute tongue pressure, task-related cervical responses did not consistently differ between groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，口面部运动会改变颈部肌肉的力学特性，在有或没有慢性颈痛的人群中都如此。尽管慢性颈痛组的舌压较低，但口面部任务对颈部肌肉的整体影响似乎相似。这加强了我们对颈部和口面部系统相互作用的理解，提醒你在评估颈痛患者时，别忘了检查口面部功能，它可能是一部分问题的来源。
items.titleZh: 慢性颈痛患者与健康个体在口面部运动任务中颈部肌肉力学特性的变化
items.summaryZh: 在 84 名成人中，口面部运动任务显著改变了胸锁乳突肌和斜方肌的颈部肌肉力学特性（如频率、僵硬度、松弛时间、蠕变），无论其是否有慢性颈痛。尽管颈痛组的舌压绝对值较低，但与任务相关的颈部反应在两组间并未持续表现出差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Orofacial motor tasks appear to alter cervical muscle mechanics, regardless of chronic neck pain status, though the chronic neck pain group did exhibit lower absolute tongue pressure. This bolsters the idea of functional interplay between the cervical and orofacial systems. When assessing neck pain, remember to screen for orofacial contributions; they could be part of the picture.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果外推性受限于所测量的特定肌肉和任务。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and generalizability is limited by the specific muscles and tasks measured.

items.title: Wearable Sensors Predict Exertion Without Changes in Pulse Rate for Frail End-Stage Kidney Disease Patients
items.summary: A study of 13 ESKD patients and 13 healthy controls found that multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improved the prediction of perceived exertion (RMSE 1.33) in ESKD patients, whose pulse rate alone was insufficient due to beta-blocker use and lower physical capacity, highlighting the need for distinct algorithms for this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在衰弱的终末期肾病（ESKD）患者中，传统的脉率监测不足以预测运动劳累程度，而多模态可穿戴传感器能显著提高劳累预测的准确性。这提示你在为 ESKD 患者进行术前康复时，需要采用更先进、多维度的监测技术，而非依赖单一脉率指标。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴传感器在衰弱终末期肾病患者中无需脉率变化即可预测劳累
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 13 名终末期肾病（ESKD）患者和 13 名健康对照的研究发现，多模态可穿戴传感器显著提高了 ESKD 患者劳累程度的预测准确性（RMSE 1.33）。由于 ESKD 患者使用β受体阻滞剂且体能较低，仅依赖脉率不足以预测劳累，这凸显了为该人群开发独特算法的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that traditional pulse rate monitoring is insufficient to predict exertion in frail end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) patients, and multi-modal wearable sensors significantly improve exertion prediction accuracy. This suggests that when conducting prehabilitation for ESKD patients, you need to adopt more advanced, multi-dimensional monitoring technologies rather than relying solely on pulse rate.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（ESKD 组和对照组各 13 人），且为一项概念验证研究，结果的普适性需更大规模临床试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (13 participants per group for ESKD and controls) and is a proof-of-concept study, requiring larger clinical trials to validate generalizability.

items.title: From "Tech Fear" to Digital Self-Efficacy: A COM-B and TDF Analysis of Tele-Exercise Engagement in Older Adults at Risk of Falls
items.summary: A qualitative study embedded in an RCT found that tele-exercise is feasible and acceptable for 25 older adults at risk of falls, despite initial digital literacy barriers, with participants successfully engaging and fostering digital self-efficacy through targeted behavior change techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使老年患者在基线时数字素养较低，远程运动干预仍然可行且可接受，且依从性高。这提示你可以在跌倒风险老年人群中推广远程运动方案，不必过分担忧数字技术障碍，而应侧重于提供技术支持和个性化的行为改变技术。
items.titleZh: 从“技术恐惧”到数字自我效能：对跌倒风险老年人远程运动参与的COM-B和TDF分析
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌入随机对照试验的定性研究发现，远程运动对于25名有跌倒风险的老年人是可行且可接受的，尽管初始存在数字素养障碍，但参与者通过有针对性的行为改变技术成功参与并培养了数字自我效能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that telerehabilitation for exercise is feasible and acceptable for older adults at risk of falls, even with low baseline digital literacy, showing high adherence. This suggests you can promote tele-exercise programs in this population without excessive concern about digital barriers, focusing instead on technical support and tailored behavior change techniques.
items.limitation: 这是一项嵌套于RCT的定性研究，样本量较小（25名参与者），且结果基于对干预后的访谈，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study nested within an RCT, with a small sample size (25 participants), and results are based on post-intervention interviews, which may involve recall bias.

items.title: Education and training pathways for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists: a qualitative study investigating competency.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored advanced musculoskeletal practitioners' experiences with education and training in Tasmania, finding that current workplace-based training supports clinical expertise but lacks health-service collaboration, and highlighting opportunities for integrating external training and aligning policy and regulation to support competence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了澳大利亚高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师在教育培训方面的系统性差距，强调了政策与监管亟需调整以支持能力提升。这提示你需要关注本地区（或借鉴澳大利亚的经验）PT 高级执业资格的认证与培训路径，并思考如何弥补培训需求与现有系统间的鸿沟。
items.titleZh: 高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的教育与培训路径：一项探讨能力的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了塔斯马尼亚地区高级肌肉骨骼实践者在教育和培训方面的经验，发现当前的工作场所培训支持临床专业知识但缺乏医疗服务协作，并强调了整合外部培训以及调整政策和法规以支持能力的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals systemic gaps in education and training for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists in Australia, highlighting the urgent need for policy and regulatory alignment to support competence. This prompts you to consider the certification and training pathways for advanced PT practice in your region (or learn from Australia's experience), and how to bridge the gap between training needs and current systems.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（12名参与者），结果主要反映塔斯马尼亚地区AMPs的经验。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (12 participants), reflecting the experiences of AMPs primarily in Tasmania.

items.title: The new body-as-machine: a response to Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott's "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy".
items.summary: This response article acknowledges and critically reflects on a landmark contribution to critical physiotherapy scholarship, which traces the evolving concept of the body from mechanical to modulated, highlighting tensions in existing analyses and raising issues for future resolution.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评是对物理治疗学界对“身体即机器”的反思。它并不会改变你的临床操作，但能让你从理论层面更深刻地理解当前生物-心理-社会模式的局限与演变，从而更好地参与学科内部的批判性对话。
items.titleZh: 新时代的“身体即机器”：对Breedt、Tichenor和Barlott的“物理治疗中的身体诊断”一文的回应
items.summaryZh: 这篇回应文章对批判性物理治疗学术领域的一项里程碑式贡献进行了肯定和批判性反思，该贡献追溯了身体概念从机械化到调控化的演变，并指出了现有分析中的张力及未来需要解决的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically reflects on the "body-as-machine" concept in physiotherapy. It won't change your clinical practice, but offers deeper theoretical insight into the limitations and evolution of the biopsychosocial model, preparing you for critical discourse within the profession.
items.limitation: 这是一篇批判性述评，不涉及实证研究数据或临床干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a critical commentary and does not involve empirical research data or clinical intervention outcomes.

items.title: CMS CRUSH Proposed Rule Aims to Reap Nearly $90 Billion for Taxpayers in Savings by Targeting Fraud Across Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace
items.summary: CMS has proposed the "Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare" (CRUSH) rule, aiming to save nearly $90 billion by targeting fraud across Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace.
items.curatedReason: CMS 提出的 CRUSH 规则旨在通过打击 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 的欺诈行为，为纳税人节省资金。这些规定将直接影响支付方和提供者的合规要求，你需要了解其细节以确保执业符合新规。
items.titleZh: CMS CRUSH 拟议规则旨在通过打击 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 欺诈行为，为纳税人节省近900亿美元

These regulations will directly impact compliance requirements for payers and providers, and you need to understand the details to ensure your practice adheres to the new rules.

items.titleZh: 揭露可疑医疗保健综合规定（CRUSH）拟议规则 (CMS-6098-P)
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了“揭露可疑医疗保健综合规定”（CRUSH）拟议规则（CMS-6098-P），概述了打击欺诈的措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS-6098-P signals a tougher stance on healthcare fraud, and by extension, heightened scrutiny for all physical therapy practices involved in Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace. You must review every detail of this proposed rule and begin assessing its potential impact on your compliance, reimbursement processes, and daily operations.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Improper Payments
items.summary: CMS has released a fact sheet detailing improper payments for Fiscal Year 2026.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布的2026财年不当支付情况事实清单提供了关于医疗保健系统财务漏洞的最新数据。了解这些数据有助于你了解 CMS 未来在合规和欺诈预防方面的监管重点，对你的诊所运营有参考价值。
items.titleZh: 2026财年不当支付情况
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了关于2026财年不当支付情况的事实清单。

Understanding this data can help you anticipate CMS's future regulatory focus on compliance and fraud prevention, which is valuable for your clinic's operations.

items.title: Physical calibration and signal periodic updates to synchronize IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking
items.summary: A study with 15 volunteers demonstrated that combining physical calibration with signal-based periodic updates effectively synchronized wearable IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking, achieving high correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees) compared to motion capture, enabling accurate real-world kinematic monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 对膝关节屈曲的长期、连续性运动学追踪，这项方法在真实世界中有可能实现。这项小样本研究提示，你也许能通过物理校准与信号更新结合的方式，让可穿戴 IMU 系统达到长达 5 天的精确度，相关性 (r ≥ 0.971) 和 RMSD (≤ 6.2 度) 都表现不错。
items.titleZh: 用于 5 天连续膝关节屈曲跟踪的 IMU 物理校准和信号周期性更新同步方法
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 15 名志愿者的研究表明，将物理校准与基于信号的周期性更新相结合，可有效同步可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU），实现长达 5 天的膝关节屈曲连续跟踪。与运动捕捉相比，该方法实现了高相关性（r ≥ 0.971）和低均方根差（RMSD ≤ 6.2 度），从而实现准确的真实世界运动学监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term, continuous kinematic tracking of knee flexion might be achievable in real-world settings with this method. This small-sample study suggests you could achieve accurate 5-day tracking with wearable IMU systems by combining physical calibration with signal updates, showing good correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees).
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康志愿者，在临床患者人群中，长期穿戴 IMU 的依从性和同步精度可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy volunteers; adherence to long-term IMU wear and synchronization accuracy in clinical patient populations may require further validation.

items.title: Cellular health beyond body composition: phase angle suitability for breast cancer patients undergoing physical training: a randomised trial
items.summary: A randomized trial with 37 breast cancer patients found no significant between-group differences in phase angle (PhA) or body composition between home-based and hospital-supervised high-intensity training. Changes in PhA (p < 0.0001), BMI (p = 0.0377), fat mass (p = 0.0387), and muscle mass (p = 0.0449) were primarily treatment-dependent, supporting structured home-based exercise and PhA as an independent cellular health marker.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对乳腺癌患者而言，无论是居家运动还是医院监督下的高强度训练，身体成分和血参数的变化主要取决于化疗而非运动模式。这意味着你可以更灵活地为乳腺癌患者开具运动处方，同时相位角（PhA）可作为细胞和代谢状态的独立指标。
items.titleZh: 身体成分之外的细胞健康：相位角在接受体育训练的乳腺癌患者中的适用性：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 名乳腺癌患者进行的随机试验发现，居家运动组和医院监督下高强度训练组在相位角（PhA）或身体成分方面没有显著组间差异。相位角（p < 0.0001）、BMI（p = 0.0377）、脂肪量（p = 0.0387）和肌肉量（p = 0.0449）的变化主要与治疗相关，支持结构化居家运动和将 PhA 作为独立的细胞健康标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that for breast cancer patients, changes in body composition and blood parameters are primarily chemotherapy-dependent, not exercise modality-dependent, for both home-based and supervised high-intensity training. This implies greater flexibility in prescribing exercise for breast cancer patients, with phase angle (PhA) serving as an independent indicator of cellular and metabolic status.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（37 人），且居家组和医院组在训练监督强度和环境上存在差异，可能影响结果的可比性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (37 participants), and differences in supervision intensity and environment between home-based and hospital-based groups may affect comparability of results.

items.title: Increasing Efficiency in Resistance Training? Exploring a Minimalistic Approach in Supramaximal Accentuated Eccentric Loading: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes evidence on supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL), indicating its potential to promote strength gains with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week) due to high eccentric mechanical stimulus. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are sparse, and evidence on physiological adaptations primarily comes from eccentric-only training.
items.curatedReason: 超最大离心负荷 (SAEL) 训练在提高力量方面可能有效，即便训练容量很低（每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）。如果你在寻找一种高机械刺激、低训练量的方案，这可能值得尝试。但请注意，目前与传统阻力训练的直接比较研究还很有限。
items.titleZh: 提高阻力训练效率？探索超最大离心负荷中的极简主义方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述综合了超最大离心负荷（SAEL）的证据，表明其通过高离心机械刺激，有望以低训练量（例如，每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）促进力量增长。然而，与传统阻力训练的直接比较稀少，且生理适应性证据主要来自纯离心训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL) training may be effective for strength gains, even with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week). If you're looking for a high mechanical stimulus with low training volume, this might be worth exploring. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are still sparse.
items.limitation: 该综述是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且大部分证据来自高强度离心训练而非 SAEL 干预本身，缺乏与传统阻力训练的直接比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias, and much of the evidence is derived from high-intensity eccentric-only training rather than SAEL interventions, lacking direct comparisons with traditional resistance training.

items.title: BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice -
items.summary: The BJSM blog provides recent short articles on sports and exercise medicine, including hamstring strain injuries, traditional Chinese exercises for MSK disorders, CARTA algorithm for Achilles rupture, mSIT+ for concussion, and exercise guidelines.
items.curatedReason: BJSM 的这篇博客文章汇编了运动医学和骨骼肌肉健康的最新短文，但记住这只是一个概览。它适合你快速了解近期的热点话题，比如腘绳肌损伤、跟腱断裂算法和脑震荡评估，但要深究某个主题，你还得去查阅原始文献。
items.titleZh: BJSM 博客——社交媒体领先的运动医学之声
items.summaryZh: 《英国运动医学杂志》博客提供关于运动与运动医学的最新短文，涵盖腘绳肌拉伤、中医运动对肌肉骨骼疾病的帮助、跟腱断裂的 CARTA 算法、脑震荡的 mSIT+ 评估以及运动指南等。
items.curatedReasonEn: This BJSM blog post compiles recent short articles on sports and exercise medicine, but remember it's just an overview. It's useful for a quick catch-up on hot topics like hamstring strain injuries, Achilles rupture algorithms, and concussion assessment, but you'll need to chase down original sources for deeper dives.

items.title: Injury risk and physical therapy utilization following knee surgery in U.S. Army soldiers: a comparison of military and non-military treatment facilities.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 4924 U.S. Army soldiers found that those undergoing knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities (32% of cohort) had higher subsequent injury rates (79% vs. 73%) and longer physical therapy duration (8.3 vs. 7.1 weeks; p = 0.038) compared to those treated at military facilities.
items.curatedReason: 美军士兵膝关节手术后若在非军事医疗机构就医，再受伤风险更高，物理治疗时长也更长。这提示 PT 执业者评估患者预后时要考虑其治疗环境。
items.titleZh: 美军士兵膝关节手术后受伤风险与物理治疗利用率：军事与非军事医疗机构的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对 4924 名美军士兵的回顾性队列研究显示，在非军事医疗机构接受膝关节手术的士兵（占队列的 32%）再受伤率更高（79% vs. 73%），物理治疗持续时间也更长（8.3 vs. 7.1 周；p = 0.038）。
items.curatedReasonEn: U.S. Army soldiers receiving knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities face higher re-injury risk and longer PT duration. This suggests PTs should consider treatment setting when assessing patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, limiting causal inference and potentially subject to unmeasured confounders.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Aqua Steps: A Feasibility Study of a new Aquatic Exercise Therapy Intervention for Falls Prevention in Older Adults.
items.summary: A feasibility study of a new aquatic exercise intervention (Aqua Steps) with 101 older adults at high falls risk found high feasibility and acceptability. It reduced falls by 38%, fallers by 36%, and frequent fallers by 58%, with significant improvements in functional (22%-70%) and strength (10%-80%) tests.
items.curatedReason: Aqua Steps 水中运动干预对高跌倒风险老年人的跌倒预防显示出高可行性和初步积极效果。作为一种安全且受欢迎的替代方案，你可以将其作为陆上运动的补充或替代选择，特别是在平衡和力量训练方面具有潜在优势。
items.titleZh: Aqua Steps：一项针对高跌倒风险老年人跌倒预防的新型水中运动疗法干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 101 名高跌倒风险老年人的新型水中运动干预（Aqua Steps）可行性研究显示，该方案可行性高、接受度好，并使跌倒发生率降低 38%，跌倒者减少 36%，频繁跌倒者减少 58%，功能（22%-70%）和力量（10%-80%）测试均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Aqua Steps aquatic exercise intervention shows high feasibility and promising preliminary effects for falls prevention in older adults at high risk. As a safe and popular alternative, you can consider it as a complementary or alternative option to land-based exercises, especially for its potential benefits in balance and strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，虽然显示出初步积极效果，但样本量有限（101 名老年人），未进行随机对照，需要大规模 RCT 来确证其在跌倒预防中的长期有效性。
items.limitationEn: This feasibility study, while showing promising preliminary effects, had a limited sample size (101 older adults) and was not a randomized controlled trial. A large-scale RCT is needed to confirm its long-term effectiveness in falls prevention.

items.title: Who am I now? Experienced changes of occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with six adults explored the dynamic process of redeveloping occupational identity after spinal cord injury, revealing uncertainty and transformation influenced by daily activities and environmental contexts.
items.curatedReason: 对脊髓损伤患者来说，职业认同的重建是康复的关键一环。这项小样本定性研究提示，支持患者探索新的自我价值和人生叙事，能帮助他们更好地应对身份转变，尤其要关注日常活动和环境对其职业认同的影响。
items.titleZh: 我是谁？脊髓损伤后职业认同变化的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 6 名脊髓损伤成人进行的定性访谈研究发现，患者在重建职业认同过程中经历了不确定性和动态转变，受日常活动和环境因素影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Redeveloping occupational identity is crucial for individuals with spinal cord injury. This small qualitative study suggests that supporting patients in exploring new self-worth and life narratives can help them navigate identity transformation, with particular attention to how daily activities and environmental contexts influence their occupational identity.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（6 名成人），结果主要为探索性发现，不具备普适性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample size (six adults) provides exploratory findings that are not generalizable.

items.title: Does Hemiplegic Side Matter? A Cross-Sectional Study of Laterality Impacts on Mobility, Balance, Hand Dexterity, and Cognition in Stroke Patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 51 first-ever stroke patients found that left hemiplegic patients showed reduced functional mobility, poorer postural control, increased fall risk, and reduced impaired hand dexterity compared to right hemiplegic patients, while exhibiting higher cognitive scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明卒中偏瘫侧对患者的活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知有显著影响。在制定康复策略时，你应针对患者的偏瘫侧特异性缺陷进行定制化干预。
items.titleZh: 偏瘫侧有影响吗？一项横断面研究探讨卒中患者偏瘫侧对活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 51 名首次卒中患者的横断面研究发现，左侧偏瘫患者的功能活动能力、姿势控制和跌倒风险较右侧偏瘫患者差，受损手灵巧性降低但认知得分更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that the hemiplegic side in stroke patients significantly impacts mobility, balance, hand dexterity, and cognition. When developing rehabilitation strategies, you should tailor interventions to side-specific deficits.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，样本量为 51 名首次卒中患者，且仅在短期内观察，结果尚不能推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study with 51 first-ever stroke patients was observed only for a short period, and its results cannot infer causality.

items.title: Network-Based Brain Stimulation: Targeting the Frontoparietal Network for Cognitive Rehabilitation After Stroke Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs found that non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) targeting the frontoparietal network significantly improved executive function (Hedges' g = 0.48), working memory (g = 0.41), and attention (g = 0.38) in stroke survivors, with superior outcomes when combined with cognitive training.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后认知障碍患者，可以考虑将非侵入性脑刺激（NIBS）与认知训练结合。这项对 21 项 RCT 的系统综述表明，这种干预能中等程度改善执行功能、工作记忆和注意力，效果比单用 NIBS 更好。
items.titleZh: 基于网络的脑刺激：靶向额顶叶网络用于卒中后认知康复的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 21 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，靶向额顶叶网络的非侵入性脑刺激（NIBS）显著改善了卒中幸存者的执行功能（Hedges' g = 0.48）、工作记忆（g = 0.41）和注意力（g = 0.38），且与认知训练结合时效果更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke survivors with cognitive impairment, integrating non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) with cognitive training is a viable option. This systematic review of 21 RCTs indicates a moderate improvement in executive function, working memory, and attention, with better outcomes than NIBS alone.
items.limitation: 现有证据主要来自短期试验，且不同研究的 NIBS 刺激参数和方案存在异质性，长期临床效用尚需标准化、影像学引导的进一步研究来验证。
items.limitationEn: Existing evidence is mainly from short-term trials, and NIBS stimulation parameters and protocols vary across studies. Long-term clinical utility requires further standardized, neuroimaging-guided research for validation.

items.title: Newsroom Articles | CMS
items.summary: CMS released the 2027 Medicare Part A and Part B premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance on November 17, 2026, and also issued the proposed Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare (CRUSH) rule on November 16, 2026, aimed at strengthening program integrity and saving nearly $90 billion over 10 years by targeting fraud, waste, and abuse.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了 2027 年 Medicare A/B 部分的保费和免赔额，并提出了 CRUSH 规则以打击医保欺诈。这些政策直接影响美国 PT 执业的报销环境和合规性要求，你必须密切关注以调整未来的执业和运营策略。
items.titleZh: CMS 新闻稿：2027 年 Medicare 保费与 CRUSH 反欺诈拟议规则
items.summaryZh: CMS 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日发布了 2027 年 Medicare A 部分和 B 部分的保费、免赔额和共同保险，并于 2026 年 11 月 16 日发布了拟议的《综合规定以揭露可疑医疗保健》（CRUSH）规则，旨在加强项目完整性，并通过打击欺诈、浪费和滥用在 10 年内节省近 900 亿美元。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released 2027 Medicare Part A/B premiums and deductibles and proposed the CRUSH rule to combat healthcare fraud. These policies directly impact reimbursement and compliance requirements for PT practice in the US, and you must pay close attention to adjust future practice and operational strategies.

items.title: Comparative diagnostic utility of SPECT-CT versus MRI and CT in chronic low back pain.
items.summary: In a retrospective cohort of 122 patients with chronic low back pain, SPECT-CT positivity was moderately and independently associated with Modic changes, advanced Pfirrmann grade, and vacuum disc/facet phenomena on MRI/CT, but findings were frequently discordant, suggesting SPECT-CT may complement other imaging.
items.curatedReason: SPECT-CT 与 MRI/CT 在慢性腰痛诊断中的关联度中等，但代谢和结构发现并非可互换。在疼痛管理中考虑 SPECT-CT 作为辅助工具时，请记住其临床效用（即能否识别症状水平）仍需结果验证。
items.titleZh: SPECT-CT 对比 MRI 和 CT 在慢性腰痛中的诊断效用：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 122 例慢性腰痛患者的回顾性队列研究显示，SPECT-CT 阳性与 MRI/CT 上的 Modic 改变、Pfirrmann 晚期分级、椎间盘真空征和椎小关节真空征存在中度独立关联，但影像学结果常不一致，提示 SPECT-CT 可作为其他影像学检查的补充。
items.curatedReasonEn: SPECT-CT shows moderate association with MRI/CT findings in chronic low back pain, but metabolic and structural findings are not interchangeable. When considering SPECT-CT as an adjunct in pain management, remember its clinical utility—i.e., whether it identifies symptomatic levels—still requires outcome-based validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性单中心队列研究，且仅关注 SPECT-CT 阳性与结构性退行性病变的关联，未验证其与患者症状改善或功能预后的直接关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective single-center cohort study focused only on the association between SPECT-CT positivity and structural degenerative findings, without validating its direct relationship with patient symptom improvement or functional prognosis.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Fake nurse given good behaviour bond following Ahpra prosecution
items.summary: A Queensland woman was placed on a $2500 good behaviour bond and ordered to pay $1750 in legal costs by Ahpra for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse while employed as an Assistant in Nursing and in a teacher aide application, highlighting the regulator's strong stance against misrepresentation of professional qualifications.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名女子因谎称注册护士而被判守行保释，这再次提醒你，医疗执业者必须如实反映其资历和注册状态。在澳大利亚执业的物理治疗师应意识到 AHPRA 对虚假陈述注册情况的零容忍立场，以避免类似的法律后果。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局：假冒护士被判守行保释
items.summaryZh: 一名昆士兰女子因在担任助理护士期间和申请教师助理职位时谎称自己是注册护士，被澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）判处 2500 澳元守行保释，并需支付 1750 澳元法律费用，这凸显了监管机构对虚报专业资质的严厉立场。
items.curatedReasonEn: An Australian woman received a good behavior bond for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse, serving as a reminder that healthcare practitioners must truthfully represent their qualifications and registration status. Physical therapists practicing in Australia should be aware of AHPRA's zero-tolerance stance on misrepresenting registration to avoid similar legal consequences.

items.title: Patients treated with rehabilitation alone after anterior cruciate ligament injury display greater muscle strength symmetry, yet lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to reconstruction: A Cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients found that those treated with rehabilitation alone for ACL injury had greater muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to the ACL reconstruction group.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型横断面研究提示，单纯康复治疗的 ACL 损伤患者，肌力对称性更好，但绝对肌力（矫正体重后）低于重建组。评估非手术路径时，请注意权衡这种差异。
items.titleZh: 3,093 例患者的横断面研究：ACL 损伤后仅接受康复治疗者比重建者显示出更好的肌力对称性，但绝对肌力（矫正体重后）更低
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3,093 例 ACL 损伤患者的横断面研究显示，仅接受康复治疗的患者在所有随访中肌力对称性更好，但除了 10 周时的覥绳肌力外，未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（体重标准化后）均低于重建组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cross-sectional study suggests that ACL injury patients treated with rehabilitation alone exhibit better muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute strength (normalized to bodyweight) compared to the reconstruction group. When evaluating non-operative pathways, consider this trade-off.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且患者分组受年龄和活动水平影响，存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality, and patient grouping was influenced by age and activity level, introducing selection bias.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Efficacy of action observation therapy in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nine RCTs (n=348) found action observation therapy significantly improved cognitive function (SMD = 0.86, 95% CI = 0.53 to 1.19), activities of daily living (SMD = 0.67, 95% CI = 0.22 to 1.12), and naming aphasia (SMD = 0.53, 95% CI = 0.01 to 1.05) in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment.
items.curatedReason: 动作观察疗法对痴呆或认知障碍患者的认知功能、ADL 和命名性失语有显著改善作用。这为认知康复提供了强有力的非药物干预选择。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法对痴呆或认知障碍患者的疗效：一项随机试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 9 项随机对照试验（n=348）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，动作观察疗法显著改善了痴呆或认知障碍患者的认知功能（SMD = 0.86，95% CI = 0.53 至 1.19）、日常生活活动（ADL）（SMD = 0.67，95% CI = 0.22 至 1.12）和命名性失语（SMD = 0.53，95% CI = 0.01 至 1.05）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Action observation therapy significantly improved cognitive function, ADL, and naming aphasia in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment. This offers a strong non-pharmacological intervention option for cognitive rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量和样本量存在异质性，可能影响结果的总体稳健性。
items.limitationEn: There was heterogeneity in methodological quality and sample size among the included studies, potentially impacting the overall robustness of the results.

items.title: Exploratory analysis of the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff.
items.summary: A retrospective study of 65 pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) patients found that those under 3 years old receiving combined Salter and femoral osteotomy showed superior radiographic and functional outcomes (e.g., McKay excellent/good rates: 97.1% vs 64.5%) and lower avascular necrosis risk (0% vs 12.9%) compared to patients aged 3 years or older, with a mean follow-up of 8 ± 2.5 years.
items.curatedReason: 对发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患儿，3 岁以下接受 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术联合治疗的患者，功能结局和股骨头坏死（AVN）风险可能优于 3 岁及以上的患儿。这支持早期干预的价值。
items.titleZh: 年龄分层对儿童发育性髋关节发育不良联合 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术疗效影响的探索性分析（以 3 年为分界点）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 65 名儿童发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患者的回顾性研究发现，3 岁以下接受 Salter 截骨术和股骨截骨术联合治疗的患者，其影像学和功能结局（如 McKay 优良率：97.1% vs 64.5%）以及股骨头坏死（AVN）风险（0% vs 12.9%）均优于 3 岁及以上的患者，平均随访时间为 8 ± 2.5 年。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), those under 3 years receiving combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy may have better functional outcomes and lower avascular necrosis (AVN) risk than those aged 3 years or older. This supports the value of early intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，存在固有偏倚，且多变量回归的估计值不稳定，不能确证年龄的独立效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective study with inherent biases, and the unstable estimates from multivariable regression preclude confirmation of an independent age effect.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation applied simultaneously with exercise therapy in patellofemoral pain: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, randomized pilot trial (n=30) found no additional short-term benefit of neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) combined with exercise therapy for pain, function, or quadriceps strength in patellofemoral pain, compared to exercise with sham stimulation. A small increase in quadriceps muscle thickness was observed in the NMES group (p = .03, Cohen's d = -0.27).
items.curatedReason: 对髌股疼痛患者，电刺激联合运动疗法在短期内未显示出额外益处，除了股四头肌厚度的小幅增加。避免将 NMES 作为常规辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 髌股疼痛患者同时施加神经肌肉电刺激联合运动疗法的效果：一项单盲、随机、假对照试点试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、随机试点试验（n=30）发现，对髌股疼痛患者，与假刺激相比，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合运动疗法在短期内对疼痛、功能或股四头肌力量没有额外益处。NMES 组观察到股四头肌厚度小幅增加（p = .03，Cohen's d = -0.27）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patellofemoral pain patients, NMES combined with exercise therapy showed no additional short-term benefits beyond a small increase in quadriceps muscle thickness. Avoid routine use of NMES as an adjunct.
items.limitation: 这是一项小型试点研究，仅有 30 名参与者，可能无法检测出小到中等效应量的真实差异。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot trial with only 30 participants, potentially underpowered to detect small to moderate effect sizes.

items.title: Satisfaction with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation in people with Parkinson's disease and its association with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life: a longitudinal national register study.
items.summary: A longitudinal national register study (n=173) in Sweden found that over 82% of Parkinson's disease patients were satisfied with outpatient rehabilitation. Higher satisfaction was associated with greater life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge, with some associations differing by sex and age, though these links were less evident at 1-year follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 高满意度与出院时的生活满意度和健康相关生活质量相关，但长期随访中这种关联减弱。这提示您，衡量患者康复体验和报告结局至关重要，尤其是在帕金森病康复中。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者对医院门诊康复的满意度及其与生活满意度及健康相关生活质量的关联：一项纵向国家登记研究
items.summaryZh: 一项瑞典国家纵向登记研究（n=173）发现，超过 82% 的帕金森病患者对门诊康复满意。较高的满意度与出院时更高的生活满意度和健康相关生活质量相关，某些关联因性别和年龄而异，但在 1 年随访时这些关联减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: High satisfaction was associated with life satisfaction and HRQoL at discharge, but this link weakened at 1-year follow-up. This suggests that measuring patient rehabilitation experiences and reported outcomes is crucial, especially in Parkinson's disease rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项基于瑞典国家登记数据的观察性研究，可能存在未测量的混杂因素影响结果。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study based on Swedish national register data, and unmeasured confounders might influence the results.

items.title: 3D Biomechanics of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries in Football: What We Have Learned in the Last Five Years.
items.summary: This review synthesizes over five years of research on 3D biomechanics of ACL injuries in elite male football players, identifying a sequence of multiplanar knee rotations and marked inter-individual variability in whole-body kinematics, proposing biomechanically informed injury mitigation strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述提醒我们，ACL 损伤不仅仅是单一平面的问题，而是复杂的膝关节多平面旋转序列。更重要的是，它强调了显著的个体差异，提示我们在预防和康复中必须超越“一刀切”的方案，转向针对个体全身姿态的精细化策略。
items.titleZh: 足球中前交叉韧带损伤的 3D 生物力学：过去五年我们学到了什么
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述综合了过去五年精英男子足球运动员 ACL 损伤 3D 生物力学的研究，确定了膝关节多平面旋转的序列和全身运动的显著个体差异，并提出了基于生物力学的损伤缓解策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies that ACL injuries involve a complex sequence of multiplanar knee rotations, not just isolated movements. Crucially, it highlights significant inter-individual variability, underscoring that our prevention and rehabilitation strategies must move beyond 'one-size-fits-all' and become more nuanced, especially regarding context-dependent whole-body postures.
items.limitation: 该综述基于对已发生损伤的运动学重建，可能存在回顾性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The review is based on kinematic reconstructions of existing injuries, which may introduce retrospective bias.

items.title: Previewing gaze behaviours predict gait speed, risky stepping strategies and cognitive dual task cost in older adults
items.summary: A study of 29 older adults found that greater gaze sequence complexity during route previewing predicted lower cognitive dual-task cost during walking, while larger gaze transitions predicted slower walking speed, suggesting visual planning impacts locomotor and cognitive outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 29 名老年人的观察研究提示，他们预习路线时的视线模式与步行表现和认知负荷相关。这表明，优化视觉策略，比如引导患者在行走前更有效地规划视线，可能有助于降低双任务成本并提升步速，尤其值得你在步态训练中尝试。
items.titleZh: 老年人预览注视行为预测步态速度、风险步态策略和认知双任务成本
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 29 名老年人的研究发现，路线预览期间较高的注视序列复杂性预示着步行时较低的认知双任务成本，而较大的注视转换预示着较慢的步行速度，这表明视觉规划会影响运动和认知结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 29 older adults suggests that their gaze patterns during route previewing correlate with subsequent walking performance and cognitive load. It implies that optimizing visual strategies—perhaps by training patients to plan their gaze more effectively before walking—could reduce dual-task costs and improve walking speed. This is certainly worth exploring in your gait training protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=29），结果可能难以广泛推广。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=29), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Selective distal upper extremity recovery following targeted dentate nucleus temporal interference stimulation in stroke-double-blind, sham-controlled randomized controlled trial with resting-state EEG
items.summary: A double-blind, sham-controlled RCT (N=47) showed that 10 sessions of dentate nucleus-targeted tTIS combined with rehabilitation significantly improved FMA-UE (adjusted mean difference 3.98 points, p = 0.006) and ARAT (adjusted mean difference 2.98 points, p = 0.005) in subacute stroke patients, particularly for distal motor control (d=2.46, p<0.001), compared to sham.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量RCT首次证实，靶向齿状核的经颅时间干涉刺激（tTIS）联合常规康复，能显著改善亚急性卒中患者的上肢运动功能，特别是远端控制。它为临床带来了新的神经调控干预手段，提示我们可以在现有康复方案中探索结合tTIS来提升卒中上肢功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 靶向齿状核经颅时间干涉刺激在卒中患者中选择性远端上肢功能恢复：一项双盲、假对照随机对照试验与静息态脑电图研究
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲、假对照随机对照试验（N=47）显示，10次靶向齿状核的经颅时间干涉刺激结合康复治疗，显著改善了亚急性卒中患者的FMA-UE（调整均数差3.98分，p = 0.006）和ARAT（调整均数差2.98分，p = 0.005），尤其是在远端运动控制方面（d=2.46，p<0.001），优于假刺激。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT is the first to confirm that targeted dentate nucleus temporal interference stimulation (tTIS) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves upper extremity motor function, especially distal control, in subacute stroke patients. It introduces a new neuromodulation intervention to clinical practice, suggesting exploration of tTIS integration into existing rehabilitation protocols to enhance stroke upper limb recovery.
items.limitation: 研究的随访期较短（仅短时改善），且未完全阐明神经生理学变化的临床意义和个体治疗反应的长期验证，外推至所有卒中患者应谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period (only short-term improvement), and the clinical significance of neurophysiological changes and long-term validation of individual treatment responses are not fully elucidated, thus extrapolation to all stroke patients should be cautious.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Different Neuromuscular Training Modalities and Doses on Lower-Limb Injury Prevention in Athletes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 RCTs (27,663 participants) found NMT was associated with reduced lower-limb injury risk (RR = 0.72, 95% CI 0.64–0.82), with structured and multidimensional programs showing favorable pooled estimates. However, overall certainty of evidence was very low, and dose-related findings were exploratory.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对27,663名参与者的系统综述提示，神经肌肉训练（NMT）可能降低下肢损伤风险（RR=0.72），但证据的确定性非常低。虽然结构化和多维度NMT看起来有益，但在临床实践中，你需要谨慎评估其应用，并关注患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉训练模式和剂量对运动员下肢损伤预防的比较效果：一项系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含27项RCT（27,663名参与者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，神经肌肉训练（NMT）与下肢损伤风险降低相关（RR = 0.72，95% CI 0.64–0.82），其中结构化和多维方案显示出有利的汇总估计。然而，证据的整体确定性非常低，且剂量相关发现为探索性结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review of 27,663 participants suggests that neuromuscular training (NMT) may reduce lower-limb injury risk (RR=0.72), but the certainty of evidence is very low. While structured and multidimensional NMT appears beneficial, in clinical practice, you should cautiously evaluate its application and focus on patient adherence.
items.limitation: 证据的整体确定性非常低，特别是剂量效应分析为研究层面的关联，而非因果关系，且可能存在发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The overall certainty of evidence is very low, especially for dose-response analyses, which represent study-level associations rather than causal relationships, and potential publication bias exists.

items.title: Body-weight support is the dominant contributor to elevated walking cost in cerebral palsy
items.summary: In children with cerebral palsy (CP, N=23) and typically developing peers (TD, N=10), body-weight support significantly reduced net energetic walking cost, with a 3.5-fold greater effect in the CP group, reducing their cost by 41% to TD levels. Mediolateral stabilization had negligible energetic effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，体重支撑是脑瘫儿童步态能耗升高的主要因素。这一发现直接指向了能耗优化康复的新策略，提示物理治疗师在设计脑瘫儿童步态训练时，应优先考虑提供重力支撑，可能比侧向稳定干预更能有效降低其行走能耗。
items.titleZh: 体重支撑是脑瘫儿童行走能耗升高的主要因素
items.summaryZh: 对脑瘫（CP，N=23）儿童和典型发育（TD，N=10）同伴的研究发现，体重支撑显著降低了行走净能耗，在CP组中的效果是TD组的3.5倍，使CP组能耗降低41%至TD组水平。内侧-外侧稳定对能耗影响可忽略不计。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that body-weight support is the dominant contributor to elevated walking cost in children with cerebral palsy. This finding directly points to new strategies for energy-optimized rehabilitation, suggesting that physical therapists, when designing gait training for children with CP, should prioritize providing gravitational support, which may be more effective than mediolateral stabilization in reducing walking energy cost.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（CP组23人），且在固定非维度速度下进行，结果的外推性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (23 in the CP group) and was conducted at a fixed non-dimensional speed, which might limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Aerobic and aerobic–cognitive training in knee osteoarthritis following acute exercise intensity selection: a two-phase randomised controlled trial protocol
items.summary: This two-phase randomized controlled trial protocol will investigate aerobic and aerobic-cognitive training in knee osteoarthritis, aiming to select optimal exercise intensity (55%, 65%, or 75% HRR) based on acute sensory and hemodynamic responses (N=60 in Phase I) and evaluate their efficacy against physical-agent therapy (N=108 in Phase II) on pain (primary outcome: NRS at 12 weeks).
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT方案意在找到膝骨关节炎患者有氧训练的最佳强度（55%、65%或75% HRR），并结合认知训练。若未来结果积极，你或许能为患者制定更精准的个性化运动处方，但目前仍是研究的早期阶段。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者急性运动强度选择后的有氧和有氧-认知训练：一项两阶段随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这项两阶段随机对照试验方案将研究膝骨关节炎患者的有氧和有氧-认知训练。研究旨在根据急性感觉和血流动力学反应选择最佳运动强度（I期60名受试者），并在II期评估其对疼痛（12周NRS为主要结局）的疗效，共招募108名受试者，与物理因子治疗进行比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This trial protocol aims to optimize exercise intensity for knee osteoarthritis and explore the potential of cognitive training combined with aerobic exercise. It highlights the role of pain processing, sensory responses, and brain hemodynamics in KOA rehabilitation, with future results potentially informing more personalized exercise prescriptions.
items.limitation: 作为一项试验方案，尚未获得实际结果，其结论和临床意义仍待未来研究验证。
items.limitationEn: As a trial protocol, no actual results are available yet, and its conclusions and clinical implications await future validation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A systematic review of robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation: from design to clinical evidence
items.summary: A systematic review of 19 human subject studies (2015-2025) on robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation found reported improvements in walking speed, step length, and symmetry across populations, with some studies showing reductions in metabolic cost and improved functional mobility. However, evidence for sustained clinical impact remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了髋关节外骨骼机器人在步态康复中的应用进展，肯定了其在改善步速、步长和对称性方面的短期益处。它为神经康复物理治疗师提供了当前技术局限性（标准化欠缺、成本高、真实世界可转移性差）的清晰认识，指导未来在临床实践中更审慎地应用这些设备。
items.titleZh: 用于步态康复的机器人髋关节外骨骼：从设计到临床证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对19项关于机器人髋关节外骨骼步态康复研究（2015-2025）的系统综述发现，在不同人群中，步速、步长和对称性均有改善，部分研究显示代谢成本降低和功能活动度提高。然而，支持长期临床效果的证据仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review summarizes advancements in robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation, affirming their short-term benefits in improving walking speed, step length, and symmetry. It provides neurorehabilitation physical therapists with a clear understanding of current technical limitations (lack of standardization, high costs, poor real-world transferability), guiding more judicious application of these devices in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 尽管报告了改善，但证据主要来自短期和受控环境研究，尚缺乏支持长期临床影响的证据，且存在标准化指标和成本可及性等挑战。
items.limitationEn: Although improvements were reported, the evidence primarily comes from short-term and controlled environment studies, lacking evidence to support sustained clinical impact, and challenges such as standardized metrics and cost accessibility remain.

items.title: APTA State Chapters Advance Payment, Access, and Practice in 2026
items.summary: APTA state chapters secured legislative victories in 2026, advancing payment protections, expanding scope of practice, and improving patient access to physical therapy care.
items.curatedReason: APTA州分会在2026年通过立法努力，在支付、执业范围和患者可及性方面取得了显著进展。这凸显了持续的政策倡导对于物理治疗行业的重要性，提示美国地区的物理治疗师，积极参与或支持专业协会的立法工作，是推动执业环境改善的关键。
items.titleZh: APTA 州分会在2026年推动支付、准入和执业取得进展
items.summaryZh: APTA各州分会在2026年取得了立法胜利，在支付保护、执业范围扩大和改善患者获得物理治疗服务方面取得了进展。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA state chapters achieved significant legislative progress in 2026 across payment, scope of practice, and patient access. This highlights the importance of sustained policy advocacy for the physical therapy profession, suggesting that physical therapists in the US should actively participate in or support professional association legislative efforts as a key driver for improving practice environments.

items.title: APTA Report: Demand for PTs and PTAs Is Outpacing Workforce Growth
items.summary: A new APTA report reveals that in 2026, outpatient physical therapy practices saw an 11% workforce growth but a nearly 25% increase in job openings, indicating that demand for PTs and PTAs is significantly outpacing workforce growth.
items.curatedReason: APTA的报告指出，2026年物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理的需求增长远超劳动力增长，凸显了行业日益增长的服务缺口。这提示物理治疗机构和执业者，应重视人才招聘和保留策略，并思考如何优化现有资源以应对不断扩大的患者需求。
items.titleZh: APTA 报告：物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理需求增长超越劳动力增长
items.summaryZh: 一份新的APTA报告显示，2026年门诊物理治疗机构的劳动力增长了11%，但职位空缺增加了近25%，表明对物理治疗师（PT）和物理治疗师助理（PTA）的需求显著超过了劳动力增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's report indicates that in 2026, the demand for physical therapists and physical therapist assistants significantly outpaced workforce growth, highlighting a widening service gap in the profession. This suggests that physical therapy practices and practitioners should prioritize recruitment and retention strategies and consider how to optimize existing resources to meet increasing patient demand.

items.title: Reported Approaches to Vaginal Pessary Use for Treating Pelvic Organ Prolapse in Women: A Secondary Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 14 RCTs on vaginal pessary use for pelvic organ prolapse (POP) found significant variation and incompleteness in reporting intervention components across TIDieR domains, hindering reproducibility in clinical practice. Only one study reported all TIDieR domains.
items.curatedReason: 这项二次分析强调了目前盆腔器官脱垂（POP）阴道子宫托干预RCTs报告细节的不足，影响了其在临床实践中的可复制性。它提醒临床物理治疗师和研究者，未来试验应更全面地描述子宫托的类型、使用方法和联合治疗，以提高证据质量和转化效率。
items.titleZh: 女性盆腔器官脱垂阴道子宫托使用方法报告分析：随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对盆腔器官脱垂（POP）阴道子宫托使用的14项RCT的二次分析发现，干预措施的报告在TIDieR领域存在显著差异和不完整性，影响了临床实践的可复制性。仅一项研究报告了所有TIDieR领域。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis highlights inadequate reporting of vaginal pessary intervention details in current RCTs for pelvic organ prolapse (POP), hindering reproducibility in clinical practice. It reminds physical therapists and researchers to comprehensively describe pessary types, usage, and combined treatments in future trials to enhance evidence quality and translation.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的是RCTs中子宫托干预报告的完整性，而非干预本身的疗效，因此不能直接提供子宫托治疗POP的临床证据强度。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on the completeness of reporting pessary interventions in RCTs, not the efficacy of the interventions themselves, so it does not directly provide clinical evidence strength for pessary treatment of POP.

items.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction Symptoms in Peruvian Women, 2025
items.summary: A national cross-sectional study of 1280 Peruvian women in 2025 found a PFD symptom prevalence of 40.1% (95% CI 35.8–44.6). Older age (aPR 3.47 for 55–64 years), multiparity (aPR 1.62), grand multiparity (aPR 1.72), and macrosomic newborn history (aPR 1.22) were independently associated with higher prevalence.
items.curatedReason: 这项秘鲁的横断面研究提供了盆底功能障碍（PFD）症状的流行病学数据及其关联因素。它提示我们，在拉美地区，老年、多产和巨大儿分娩史是PFD的高风险因素，支持了对高危人群进行主动筛查和预防性盆底护理的必要性。
items.titleZh: 2025年秘鲁女性盆底功能障碍症状的流行率及相关因素
items.summaryZh: 一项2025年针对秘鲁1280名女性进行的全国横断面研究发现，盆底功能障碍症状的流行率为40.1%（95% CI 35.8–44.6）。老年（55-64岁调整后患病率比3.47）、多产（调整后患病率比1.62）、高产次（调整后患病率比1.72）和巨大儿分娩史（调整后患病率比1.22）与较高的流行率独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Peruvian cross-sectional study provides epidemiological data on pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) symptoms and associated factors.
