It suggests that older age, multiparity, and a history of macrosomic newborns are high-risk factors for PFD in Latin America, supporting the need for active screening and preventive pelvic floor care in at-risk populations.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系；且症状评估基于患者自述问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and symptom assessment relies on self-reported questionnaires, which may involve recall bias.

items.title: Knee joint biomechanical characteristics of table tennis players based on inertial sensing technology: impact on LESS-defined risk stratification for anterior cruciate ligament injury
items.summary: In 68 table tennis players, inertial measurement units identified a peak knee valgus angle of 15.62 ± 3.48° in the high-risk ACL injury group (LESS score ≥ 5) versus 9.28 ± 2.56° in the low-risk group (p < 0.001), with an optimal cutoff of 12.5° (AUC 0.860) for distinguishing risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用惯性传感技术识别了乒乓球运动员在步停任务中过度的膝外翻角度是ACL损伤高风险的关键生物力学指标。它为运动物理治疗师提供了一种非侵入性的风险评估工具和明确的生物力学干预目标，有助于更早期地识别高危运动员并制定针对性预防方案。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性传感技术的乒乓球运动员膝关节生物力学特征：对LESS定义的ACL损伤风险分层的影响
items.summaryZh: 在68名乒乓球运动员中，惯性测量单元发现，高风险ACL损伤组（LESS评分≥5）的膝关节峰值外翻角度为15.62 ± 3.48°，而低风险组为9.28 ± 2.56°（p < 0.001），最佳区分风险的临界值为12.5°（AUC 0.860）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study used inertial sensing technology to identify excessive knee valgus angle during a step-stop task as a key biomechanical indicator of high ACL injury risk in table tennis players. It provides sports physical therapists with a non-invasive risk assessment tool and clear biomechanical intervention targets, aiding earlier identification of high-risk athletes and development of targeted prevention programs.
items.limitation: 该研究为横断面观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且ACL损伤风险评估基于LESS评分，而非实际损伤发生率，可能存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional observational study, unable to establish causality. ACL injury risk assessment was based on the LESS score, not actual injury incidence, which might be a limitation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses on median frequency of lower limb muscles during walking among cohorts at different postoperative timepoints after ACL reconstruction
items.summary: A study of 40 men (30 ACLR patients, 10 healthy controls) found that medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses significantly modulated EMG median frequency of lower limb muscles during walking, with effects most pronounced in early postoperative (6-month) ACLR groups with pronated feet.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对40名男性的观察研究表明，内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫能显著调节ACL重建术后下肢肌肉的EMG中值频率，尤其在术后6个月内、伴有足部旋前的患者中效果更明显。这提示你可以考虑将特定鞋垫作为ACL重建术后早期康复的辅助手段，以优化神经肌肉活动。
items.titleZh: 内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫对ACL重建术后不同时间点患者行走时下肢肌肉中位频率的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对40名男性（30名ACL重建患者，10名健康对照）的研究发现，内侧足弓支撑和双密度鞋垫在行走时显著调节了下肢肌肉的EMG中位频率，且这种效应在早期术后（6个月）伴有扁平足的ACL重建组中最为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 40 men indicates that medial arch-support and double-density foot orthoses significantly modulate lower limb muscle EMG median frequency after ACLR, with effects more pronounced in early postoperative (6-month) patients with pronated feet. This suggests you might consider specific orthoses as an adjunct in early ACLR rehabilitation to optimize neuromuscular activity.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，而非纵向随访，无法直接反映个体康复进程中鞋垫的长期效果或 biomechanical 对齐的直接证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, not a longitudinal follow-up, and therefore cannot directly reflect the long-term effects of orthoses or direct evidence of biomechanical alignment during individual recovery.

items.title: Creating Consensus: Establishing a Definition of Sports Pharmacy and Its Emerging Role in Sports Medicine
items.summary: The US Sports Pharmacy Group established the first consensus-derived definition of sports pharmacy, emphasizing medication management, anti-doping advocacy, interprofessional collaboration, and athlete-centered ethical care, aiming to guide future education, certification, and research.
items.curatedReason: 这份关于运动药学的共识声明，首次明确定义了运动药学的范畴和职责，强调了药物管理、反兴奋剂倡导和跨专业协作的重要性。虽然直接影响物理治疗实践有限，但它为运动医学多学科团队的协作提供了清晰的界定，提示物理治疗师在团队中与其他专业（包括运动药师）进行更有效的沟通与配合。
items.titleZh: 建立共识：定义运动药学及其在运动医学中的新兴作用
items.summaryZh: 美国运动药学小组首次确立了运动药学的共识定义，强调药物管理、反兴奋剂倡导、跨专业协作和以运动员为中心的伦理护理，旨在指导未来的教育、认证和研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus statement on sports pharmacy is the first to clearly define its scope and responsibilities, emphasizing medication management, anti-doping advocacy, and interprofessional collaboration. While its direct impact on physical therapy practice is limited, it provides a clear delineation for multidisciplinary sports medicine teams, encouraging physical therapists to engage in more effective communication and collaboration with other professionals, including sports pharmacists, within the team.

items.title: Exploring association patterns among muscle mass, gait speed, and upper- and lower-limb muscle strength in sarcopenic and non-sarcopenic swiss community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional secondary analysis using portable, field-ready assessments
items.summary: A cross-sectional secondary analysis of 198 older adults (17 sarcopenic) found that lower-limb strength (LLSmax) correlated more strongly with ALM/height² in sarcopenic participants (ρ = 0.79) than upper-limb strength (ULSmax) (ρ = 0.53), while the opposite trend was observed in non-sarcopenic individuals. Gait speed was not significantly associated with any measure in the sarcopenic group.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对瑞士社区老年人的横断面分析，探讨了便携式评估工具在肌少症筛查中肌量、步速和上下肢肌力之间的关联模式。它提示下肢肌力与肌少症患者的肌量关联更强，支持在社区筛查中重视下肢肌力评估，但需更多研究验证便携式工具的诊断价值。
items.titleZh: 瑞士社区老年人肌少症与非肌少症人群中肌量、步速及上下肢肌力关联模式的探索：一项使用便携式现场评估工具的横断面二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对198名老年人（17名肌少症患者）的横断面二次分析发现，在肌少症患者中，下肢肌力（LLSmax）与附肢瘦体重/身高²的关联（ρ = 0.79）强于上肢肌力（ULSmax）（ρ = 0.53），而在非肌少症个体中则观察到相反的趋势。步速在肌少症组中与任何测量指标均无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional analysis of Swiss community-dwelling older adults explores association patterns between muscle mass, gait speed, and upper and lower limb muscle strength using portable assessment tools for sarcopenia screening. It suggests a stronger association between lower limb muscle strength and muscle mass in sarcopenic individuals, supporting the emphasis on lower limb strength assessment in community screening, but requires further research to validate the diagnostic value of portable tools.
items.limitation: 这是一项二次分析的横断面研究，样本量中肌少症亚组较小（N=17），且无法建立因果关系，其探索性发现应谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary cross-sectional analysis with a small sarcopenic subgroup (N=17) and cannot establish causality; its exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Wearable activity-sequence measures and subsequent handgrip strength in adults aged 65 years and older: measurement characteristics and longitudinal associations
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 391 adults aged 65+ found that a run-collapsed LZ76 activity-sequence measure was associated with subsequent handgrip strength (β = 0.906 kg/SD, p = 0.016, ΔR²=0.00301), while H1–H3 conditional entropy showed an imprecise association. Both measures demonstrated good within-wear agreement (ICCs of 0.775 and 0.876).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对391名65岁以上老年人的纵向研究发现，可穿戴设备记录的LZ76活动序列指标与随后的手握力相关（β=0.906 kg/SD）。这意味着你除了关注总活动量，还应留意老年患者日常活动的序列模式，这可能提供更精细的体能评估依据。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴活动序列指标与65岁及以上成人手握力的后续关联：测量特征和纵向关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对391名65岁以上成年人的纵向研究发现，一种名为run-collapsed LZ76的活动序列测量指标与随后的手握力相关（β = 0.906 kg/SD, p = 0.016, ΔR²=0.00301），而H1-H3条件熵则显示出不精确的关联。这两项指标均显示出良好的穿戴内一致性（ICC分别为0.775和0.876）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal study of 391 adults aged 65+ found that the LZ76 activity-sequence measure from wearables was associated with subsequent handgrip strength (β=0.906 kg/SD). This means you should pay attention to the temporal patterns of daily activity in older patients, beyond just total activity volume, as it may offer more refined insights for physical assessment.
items.limitation: 研究部分结果的统计学显著性不强，且某些探索性分析是在初始结局分析后进行的，可能存在偏倚，需要更多独立验证。
items.limitationEn: Some results of the study lack strong statistical significance, and certain exploratory analyses were conducted after initial outcome analyses, which may introduce bias and require further independent validation.

items.title: Acute effects of fibular repositioning taping on balance, jumping, and sprint performance in healthy individuals: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (N=90 healthy adults) found fibular repositioning taping (FRT) did not significantly differ from sham taping in Y-Balance performance, but showed greater short-term improvements in single-leg countermovement jump and 10-m sprint compared to both sham and control groups. These secondary findings were exploratory.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，腓骨复位贴扎（FRT）在急性期可改善健康个体的单腿反向跳跃和10米冲刺表现，但对Y平衡测试的改善与假贴扎无显著差异。这提示FRT可能对某些动态运动表现有短期促进作用，但在平衡改善方面证据不强，物理治疗师应根据具体临床目标审慎应用。
items.titleZh: 腓骨复位贴扎对健康个体平衡、跳跃和冲刺表现的急性影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（N=90名健康成人）发现，腓骨复位贴扎（FRT）在Y平衡表现上与假贴扎无显著差异，但在单腿反向跳跃和10米冲刺方面，FRT组比假贴扎组和对照组有更大的短期改善。这些次要发现为探索性结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that fibular repositioning taping (FRT) acutely improved single-leg countermovement jump and 10-m sprint performance in healthy individuals, but showed no significant difference from sham taping in Y-Balance test improvement. This suggests FRT might offer short-term benefits for some dynamic athletic performances, but evidence for balance improvement is not strong. Physical therapists should apply it judiciously based on specific clinical goals.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性注册，且主要结局Y平衡测试与假贴扎无显著差异，次要结局的发现是探索性的，需要进一步的确认性研究。
items.limitationEn: The study was retrospectively registered, and the primary outcome (Y-Balance test) showed no significant difference from sham taping. Secondary findings are exploratory and require further confirmatory studies.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Acute muscle responses to a single session of whole-body electromyostimulation in sedentary older men: a pilot study
items.summary: A pilot study with seven sedentary older men found a single WB-EMS session led to transient reductions in knee extensor MVIC and handgrip strength, with recovery by 72h. Muscle soreness increased, peaking at 24-72h. Muscle thickness and echo intensity showed transient increases in vastus medialis and biceps brachii.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点研究发现，单次全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）对久坐老年男性是安全且耐受的，并能引起肌肉力量的短期下降及可逆性肌肉反应。它提示WB-EMS可能作为一种低负荷的训练和康复策略，但其长期益处和最佳方案仍需进一步的大规模研究来明确。
items.titleZh: 单次全身电肌肉刺激对久坐老年男性急性肌肉反应的试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对七名久坐老年男性的试点研究发现，单次全身电肌肉刺激导致膝伸肌最大自主收缩力和握力短暂下降，并在72小时内恢复。肌肉酸痛增加，在24-72小时达到峰值。股内侧肌和肱二头肌的肌肉厚度和回声强度均出现短暂增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study found that a single session of whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) was safe and well-tolerated in sedentary older men, inducing transient reductions in muscle strength and reversible muscle responses. It suggests WB-EMS as a potential low-load training and rehabilitation strategy, but its long-term benefits and optimal protocols require further large-scale studies.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（N=7）的试点研究，无法得出强有力的结论，且仅评估了急性肌肉反应，未涉及长期功能或力量改善。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample (N=7) pilot study, precluding strong conclusions, and it only assessed acute muscle responses without addressing long-term functional or strength improvements.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Association Between Borg CR-10 Rated Perceived Exertion and Cardiorespiratory Intensity in Individuals with Coronary Heart Disease: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the association between Borg CR-10 Rated Perceived Exertion and cardiorespiratory intensity in individuals with coronary heart disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了冠心病患者Borg CR-10感知运动量表与心肺强度关联的横断面数据。它强化了Borg量表作为一种便捷、非侵入性工具，在心肺康复中指导运动强度设定的实用性，特别是在资源有限或需要自我管理的场景下。
items.titleZh: Borg CR-10感知运动量表与冠心病患者心肺强度关联的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究探讨了冠心病患者的Borg CR-10感知运动量表与心肺强度之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides cross-sectional data on the association between Borg CR-10 RPE and cardiorespiratory intensity in coronary heart disease patients. It reinforces the utility of the Borg scale as a convenient, non-invasive tool for guiding exercise intensity in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, especially in resource-limited or self-managed settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚，影响了Borg量表在不同时间点的应用准确性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and may suffer from recall bias, affecting the accuracy of Borg scale application at different time points.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: One-year prevalence and factors associated with injury in Japanese collegiate American footballers - a cross-sectional observational survey study
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 896 Japanese collegiate American footballers found a 1-year injury prevalence of 62%. Factors associated with higher injury odds included higher university year, greater sport experience, five or more practice days per week, national level of play, and athletic trainer support.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对日本大学美式橄榄球运动员的横断面研究提供了该人群损伤流行率和相关因素的独特数据。它提示我们需关注高年级、经验丰富、训练频率高、国家级水平运动员的损伤预防，并强调运动训练师支持的重要性，有助于制定更精准的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 日本大学美式橄榄球运动员损伤一年流行率及相关因素：一项横断面观察性调查研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对896名日本大学美式橄榄球运动员的横断面调查发现，一年内损伤流行率为62%。与较高损伤几率相关的因素包括大学高年级、运动经验更丰富、每周训练五天或以上、国家级比赛水平以及运动训练师支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study on Japanese collegiate American footballers provides unique data on injury prevalence and associated factors in this population. It highlights the need to focus on injury prevention for senior, experienced, high-frequency training, and national-level athletes, emphasizing the importance of athletic trainer support, which can inform more precise intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖于自我报告问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and data relies on self-reported questionnaires, which may involve recall bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: APTA, NSCA Return-to-Play Summit Highlights Rehab, Performance
items.summary: The APTA and NSCA hosted a Return-to-Play Performance Summit, bringing together rehabilitation and performance professionals to advance education and foster interprofessional connections.
items.curatedReason: APTA与NSCA的联合峰会，体现了物理治疗与体能训练专业在重返运动领域的协同。这强化了多学科合作的重要性，提示物理治疗师在为运动员提供康复和表现提升服务时，应积极寻求与其他专业人士的协作机会。
items.titleZh: APTA、NSCA 重返赛场峰会强调康复与体能表现
items.summaryZh: APTA与NSCA联合举办了一场重返赛场表现峰会，汇集了康复和体能专业人士，旨在促进教育和加强跨专业联系。
items.curatedReasonEn: The joint APTA and NSCA summit highlights the synergy between physical therapy and strength and conditioning professions in return-to-play. This reinforces the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration, suggesting physical therapists should actively seek opportunities to collaborate with other professionals when providing rehabilitation and performance enhancement services to athletes.

items.title: Virtual and Augmented Reality Feedback During Robotic Gait Training Acutely Modulate Paretic Muscle Activation, Limb Loading, and Propulsion-Related Mechanics in Chronic Hemiparetic Stroke: A Randomised Crossover Trial.
items.summary: A randomized crossover trial found that virtual reality (VR) and screen-based augmented reality (AR) feedback during robot-assisted gait training acutely and differentially modulated paretic muscle activation, limb loading, and propulsion-related mechanics in chronic hemiparetic stroke, with sequential combined VR + AR producing the broadest acute modulation.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机交叉试验显示，虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）反馈在机器人辅助步态训练中能急性且差异性地调节卒中偏瘫患者的患侧步态力学，联合使用效果最广。这意味着未来可个性化选择或组合VR/AR模式，以更精准地改善患者步态。
items.titleZh: 机器人步态训练中虚拟现实和增强现实反馈急性调节慢性偏瘫卒中患者患侧肌肉激活、肢体负荷及推进相关力学：一项随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉试验发现，在机器人辅助步态训练中，虚拟现实（VR）和屏幕增强现实（AR）反馈能急性且差异性地调节慢性偏瘫卒中患者的患侧肌肉激活、肢体负荷和推进相关力学；顺序结合VR+AR能产生最广泛的急性调节效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized crossover trial shows that virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) feedback acutely and differentially modulate paretic gait mechanics in robot-assisted gait training for chronic hemiparetic stroke, with combined use yielding the broadest effects. This suggests future potential for personalized VR/AR selection or combination to precisely improve patient gait.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了急性效应，尚需长期随访来确定这些急性、任务特异性效应是否能转化为长期功能恢复。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed acute effects; long-term follow-up is needed to determine if these acute, task-specific effects translate into long-term functional recovery.

items.title: Venous flow dynamics in post-stroke hemiparetic lower extremity motor dysfunctions.
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study (n=43) in Türkiye found significantly reduced venous pump capacity (1.07 ± 0.43% vs. 2.24 ± 0.74%) and venous refilling time (9.26 ± 3.42 vs. 19.4 seconds) in post-stroke hemiparetic limbs compared to unaffected sides, with interlimb venous refilling time asymmetry correlating with Brunnstrom stage (ρ = -0.35, p = 0.022) and Barthel Index (ρ = -0.38, p = 0.012).
items.curatedReason: 卒中偏瘫肢体存在显著的静脉血流障碍，这与小腿肌肉泵功能受损有关，并可能与运动恢复和功能状态相关。将静脉评估纳入卒中康复有助于预防血栓栓塞并发症并改善循环预后。
items.titleZh: 卒中偏瘫下肢运动功能障碍中的静脉血流动力学
items.summaryZh: 土耳其一项回顾性横断面研究（n=43）发现，卒中后偏瘫肢体的静脉泵容量（1.07 ± 0.43% vs. 2.24 ± 0.74%）和静脉再充盈时间（9.26 ± 3.42 vs. 19.4 秒）较未受影响侧显著降低，且肢体间静脉再充盈时间不对称与 Brunnstrom 分期（ρ = -0.35, p = 0.022）和 Barthel 指数（ρ = -0.38, p = 0.012）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke hemiparetic limbs exhibit significant venous flow impairment, linked to impaired calf muscle pump function, and potentially associated with motor recovery and functional status. Integrating venous assessment into stroke rehabilitation may help prevent thromboembolic complications and improve circulatory outcomes.
items.limitation: 回顾性横断面设计无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective cross-sectional design cannot establish causality, and the sample size was small.

items.title: Current Clinical Practice and Barriers to Instrumented Gait Assessment in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A web-based cross-sectional survey of Japanese physiotherapists (n=329) found that 91.2% recognized the need for instrumented gait assessment in stroke rehabilitation, but only 39.8% used it routinely, citing equipment unavailability, excessive measurement time, and interpretation difficulty as key barriers.
items.curatedReason: 尽管日本神经物理治疗师普遍认为仪器化步态评估有必要，但常规应用仍有限。若要将其整合到卒中康复中，需要更便捷、便携且具备自动分析和结果解读支持的系统。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中仪器化步态评估的当前临床实践与障碍：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对日本物理治疗师（n=329）的网络横断面调查发现，91.2%的受访者认为卒中康复中仪器化步态评估有必要，但仅39.8%的人常规使用，主要障碍是设备不可用、测量时间过长和结果解读困难。
items.curatedReasonEn: While Japanese neurological physical therapists widely perceive instrumented gait assessment as necessary, its routine use remains limited. Integrating it into stroke rehabilitation requires more time-efficient, portable systems with automated analysis and interpretation support.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，难以建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional survey, which limits the ability to establish causality and may involve recall bias.

items.title: Integrated care for chronic musculoskeletal (MSK) disorders is promising but incomplete: a scoping review of MSK service-delivery approaches across systems
items.summary: A scoping review of 97 papers identified six key themes in integrated care for chronic MSK conditions, highlighting variability in conceptualization and delivery, frequent involvement of physiotherapists (67%), but limited evidence of whole-system integration and caregiver involvement.
items.curatedReason: PT 在慢性 MSK 疾病的整合照护中参与度很高（67%），但整体系统整合和照护者参与度不足，提醒我们，目前的「整合」还不够，PT 需要更主动地推动全系统层面的协作。别只盯着自己的那一亩三分地。
items.titleZh: 慢性肌肉骨骼疾病整合照护的现状与局限：一项系统范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 97 篇论文的范围综述，总结了慢性肌肉骨骼疾病整合照护的六个关键主题，强调了概念化和实施的变异性、物理治疗师的高度参与（67%），但指出全系统整合和照护者参与的证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: PTs are heavily involved (67%) in integrated care for chronic MSK conditions, yet true whole-system integration and caregiver involvement remain limited. This signals that current 'integration' efforts are falling short, and PTs must proactively push for system-level collaboration, rather than just focusing on their individual scope.
items.limitation: 本综述发现，现有证据在评估家庭和照护者参与、以及跨部门全面整合方面存在不足。
items.limitationEn: This review found that existing evidence is insufficient in assessing family and caregiver involvement and comprehensive cross-sector integration.

items.title: What’s Super Intelligence? An Explainer
items.summary: CMS has published guidance on a clinical AI roadmap, outlining principles for integrating AI into healthcare, focusing on safety, reliability, progressive adoption, patient data ownership, and affordability, with plans for staged deployment and strengthened data foundations.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 发布了临床“超级智能”（即 AI）路线图，强调 AI 在医疗保健中的安全、可靠、渐进式采纳、患者数据所有权和可负担性。虽然是宏观政策，但它为你理解未来 AI 在 PT 执业中的监管和支付框架设定了基调。
items.titleZh: 什么是超级智能？一份解释器 | WebPT | WebPT
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一份关于临床 AI 路线图的指南，概述了将 AI 整合到医疗保健的原则，重点关注安全性、可靠性、渐进式采纳、患者数据所有权和可负担性，并计划分阶段部署和强化数据基础。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released a clinical "Super Intelligence" (AI) roadmap, emphasizing safe, reliable, progressive adoption, patient data ownership, and affordability in healthcare AI. While a high-level policy, it sets the tone for understanding the future regulatory and payment framework for AI in PT practice.

items.title: [Correspondence] The Lancet Group's guidance on reporting disability: make link to the ICF explicit
items.summary: Correspondence suggests that The Lancet Group's guidance on reporting disability should explicitly link to WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to enhance inclusivity in health research.
items.curatedReason: 这封信函建议《柳叶刀》杂志在残疾报告指南中明确提及WHO的国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF），这对物理治疗师理解和应用残疾分类标准具有参考意义。
items.titleZh: 书信：《柳叶刀》杂志关于残疾报告的指南：明确与ICF的联系。
items.summaryZh: 书信建议《柳叶刀》杂志关于残疾报告的指南应明确与WHO的《国际功能、残疾和健康分类》（ICF）建立联系，以增强健康研究的包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter suggests that The Lancet's disability reporting guidelines explicitly reference WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF), which is relevant for physical therapists in understanding and applying disability classification standards.

items.title: Self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb motor recovery in people with stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (8 independent cohorts) found that self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb recovery in stroke patients showed no significant advantage over other interventions (SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23 to 0.44), but may offer comparable functional benefits.
items.curatedReason: 对卒中患者而言，居家自我指导的上肢康复与常规疗法效果相当，可作为有效且可及的替代方案。当患者无法常规就诊时，不必担心居家方案效果不佳；但要注意，目前证据质量仍有提升空间。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者上肢运动功能恢复的自我指导居家康复：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖14项研究（8个独立队列）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，卒中患者上肢康复的自我指导居家方案与传统干预相比无显著优势（SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23至0.44），但可能提供相当的功能效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, self-guided home-based upper limb rehabilitation is comparable to conventional therapy, making it a viable and accessible alternative. Don't worry about inferior outcomes when patients can't attend regular appointments, but be aware that the evidence quality still needs improvement.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的干预措施在结构、持续时间和策略上差异较大，且方法学质量中等，异质性偏高，需要更高质量的研究确认疗效。
items.limitationEn: The included interventions varied significantly in structure, duration, and strategies, with moderate methodological quality and high heterogeneity, requiring higher-quality studies to confirm efficacy.

items.title: Application of the ICF in the functioning assessment of children with suspected developmental coordination difficulties.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=208) using the ICF framework found that children with probable Developmental Coordination Disorder (p-DCD) showed lower motor skills in activities and significantly lower involvement in community participation (p = 0.016) compared to typically neurodeveloping children.
items.curatedReason: 有发育性协调障碍（p-DCD）的儿童，不仅运动技能受限，在社区参与度上也会显著降低。评估这类患儿时，除了关注其动作表现，你更要深入了解他们的社交互动和日常活动参与，因为这些往往被忽视，却对其长期功能至关重要。
items.titleZh: ICF在疑似发育性协调障碍儿童功能评估中的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对208名儿童的横断面研究使用ICF框架发现，疑似发育性协调障碍（p-DCD）儿童在活动中的运动技能较低，并且在社区参与方面的投入显著更低（p = 0.016），提示运动挑战对其功能和参与有影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Children with probable Developmental Coordination Disorder (p-DCD) not only have motor skill limitations but also significantly lower community participation. When assessing these children, go beyond motor performance to explore their social interaction and daily activity involvement, as these often-overlooked aspects are crucial for their long-term function.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且研究人群来自巴西南部，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, and the study population from Southern Brazil may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Thoracic expansion and spirometry 120 days after adding diaphragmatic manual therapy to physiotherapy in non-specific low back pain: Follow-up of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A follow-up to an RCT (N=50) found that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to physiotherapy for non-specific low back pain patients significantly increased inspiratory thoracic expansion at axillary (3.38 cm), xiphoid (3.52 cm), and basal (4.12 cm) levels, as well as forced vital capacity (1.57 L) and forced expiratory volume in one second (1.49 L) at 120 days (all p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT的随访结果表明，在常规物理治疗中加入手法膈肌牵伸，能显著提高非特异性腰痛患者的吸气胸廓扩张度和肺活量，且这些改善在120天内保持稳定。虽然需要更多证据支持，但你可以考虑在腰痛患者的综合治疗方案中探索性地加入膈肌手法治疗。
items.titleZh: 在非特异性腰痛的物理治疗中加入手法膈肌治疗对胸廓扩张和肺活量的120天随访结果：一项随机对照试验的随访
items.summaryZh: 一项针对50名非特异性腰痛患者的随机对照试验的随访发现，在物理治疗中加入手法膈肌牵伸，在120天时显著增加了腋窝（3.38厘米）、剑突（3.52厘米）和基底（4.12厘米）水平的吸气胸廓扩张度，以及用力肺活量（1.57升）和第一秒用力呼气容积（1.49升）（均 p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT follow-up indicates that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to conventional physiotherapy significantly improves inspiratory thoracic expansion and spirometric values in non-specific low back pain patients, with benefits maintained at 120 days. While more evidence is needed, you might consider exploratively incorporating diaphragmatic manual therapy into comprehensive treatment plans for low back pain.
items.limitation: 该研究缺乏受试者盲法和假对照组，且使用了便携式肺活量计，结果可能需要通过使用实验室肺活量计的假对照试验进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked participant blinding and a sham comparator, and used portable spirometry, meaning findings require confirmation in sham-controlled trials using laboratory spirometry.

items.title: Older Adults and Healthcare Professionals Perspectives on Comfort, Dignity, and Safety During Technology-Assisted Transfers: A Qualitative Descriptive Study
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study with 15 older adults and 15 healthcare professionals revealed that comfort, dignity, and safety during technology-assisted transfers are interconnected and co-constructed through interactions, emphasizing the importance of relational practices, staff training, and equipment customization.
items.curatedReason: 使用辅助技术进行老年患者转移，舒适度、尊严和安全感并非孤立存在，而是医患互动中共同构建的。在技术操作之外，务必重视与患者的沟通、隐私维护和持续照护，这将显著提升患者的整体体验。
items.titleZh: 老年人和医疗专业人员对技术辅助转移中舒适度、尊严和安全性的视角：一项定性描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对15位老年人和15位医疗专业人员的定性描述性研究显示，技术辅助转移中的舒适度、尊严和安全性是相互关联并经由互动共同构建的，强调了关系实践、员工培训和设备定制的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: When using assistive technology for older adult transfers, comfort, dignity, and safety are not isolated; they are co-constructed through interactions. Beyond technical operation, you must prioritize communication, privacy, and continuous care with patients, as these significantly enhance their overall experience.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（15名老年人，15名医护人员），结果的普遍性受限，无法进行量化推断。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (15 older adults, 15 healthcare professionals), limiting the generalizability of the findings and precluding quantitative inferences.

items.title: Multimodal Prehabilitation in People Awaiting Acute Inpatient Cardiac Surgery (PreP-ACe): A single-arm feasibility study
items.summary: A single-arm feasibility study (N=17) for multimodal prehabilitation in acute inpatient cardiac surgery patients found a recruitment rate of 1.5 participants/month, 100% adherence to exercise with >80% tolerability, and no adverse events related to the intervention, indicating feasibility despite implementation challenges.
items.curatedReason: 急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复方案似乎是可行的，患者对运动的依从性和耐受性均超过80%，且未报告不良事件。这提示我们该方案有潜力，但实际推行时，你仍需应对招募、人员配备和资金等挑战。
items.titleZh: 急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复（PreP-ACe）：一项单臂可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复单臂可行性研究（N=17）显示，招募率为每月1.5人，运动依从性100%，耐受性超过80%，且无运动相关不良事件，表明该方案在实施挑战下仍具可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal prehabilitation appears feasible for acute inpatient cardiac surgery patients, with over 80% exercise adherence and tolerability, and no reported adverse events. This suggests potential for the program, but you'll still face challenges in recruitment, staffing, and funding during implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂可行性研究，样本量小（N=17），缺乏对照组，无法评估干预的实际疗效，且结论局限于可行性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm feasibility study with a small sample size (N=17) and no control group, preventing evaluation of intervention efficacy and limiting conclusions to feasibility.

items.title: Impact of Adding Fatigue-Focused Cognitive Behavior Therapy to Supervised Pilates-Based Core Stability Training on Balance and Walking in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: Adding fatigue-focused CBT to Pilates-based core stability training significantly improved balance and gait in multiple sclerosis patients, with a between-group mean difference of -0.59 in overall stability index (95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001) and 8.22 steps/min in cadence (95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001) after 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 疲劳聚焦的认知行为疗法（CBT）结合普拉提核心稳定性训练，能更显著改善多发性硬化症患者的平衡和步态，其综合效应优于单一普拉提训练。这提示 PT 在处理 MS 患者疲劳时，应考虑整合认知行为策略。
items.titleZh: 疲劳聚焦认知行为疗法结合普拉提核心稳定性训练对多发性硬化症患者平衡和步态影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对多发性硬化症患者进行的 RCT 发现，将疲劳聚焦的 CBT 添加到普拉提核心稳定性训练中，可显著改善平衡和步态，8 周后两组间总体稳定性指数平均差为 -0.59（95% CI: -0.70 至 -0.48；p < .001），步频平均差为 8.22 步/分钟（95% CI: 4.40 至 12.04；p < .001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fatigue-focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) combined with Pilates-based core stability training significantly improves balance and gait in multiple sclerosis patients, outperforming Pilates alone. This suggests PTs should consider integrating cognitive-behavioral strategies when addressing fatigue in MS patients.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明认知行为疗法的具体组成和剂量，可能影响结果的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific components and dosage of cognitive behavioral therapy, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Impact of Rehabilitation Initiation Timing on Safety and Efficacy in Patients With Acute Stroke and Concurrent Heart Failure.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 9827 acute stroke patients with heart failure found very early rehabilitation (admission day/day 1) was associated with lower in-hospital respiratory failure (RR = 0.58), lower 90-day stroke readmission (RR = 0.33), and a higher discharge Barthel Index (mean difference = 3.66) compared to delayed rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者早期康复（入院当天或第 1 天）与更低的院内呼吸衰竭风险、90 天卒中再入院率以及更高的出院 Barthel 指数相关。这支持了在心衰患者中，若血液动力学稳定，仍应尽早启动康复。
items.titleZh: 康复启动时机对急性卒中合并心力衰竭患者安全性和疗效的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 9827 例急性卒中合并心力衰竭患者的回顾性队列研究发现，非常早期康复（入院当天/第 1 天）与更低的院内呼吸衰竭（RR = 0.58）、更低的 90 天卒中再入院率（RR = 0.33）和更高的出院 Barthel 指数（平均差 = 3.66）相关，优于延迟康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early rehabilitation (on admission day or day 1) in stroke patients with concurrent heart failure is associated with lower in-hospital respiratory failure risk, 90-day stroke readmission rates, and higher discharge Barthel Index. This supports initiating rehabilitation early in heart failure patients if hemodynamically stable.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，结果存在混杂因素，且数据未能提供康复干预的详细强度和具体原因。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational study has confounding factors, and the data did not provide detailed information on rehabilitation intensity or specific reasons for delays.

items.title: Manual techniques for headache: who delivers what and where? A systematic review of randomized controlled trials with a practice-mapping analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review of 35 RCTs on manual techniques for headache found that spinal manipulation was predominant (60%) and applied mainly to tension-type (40%) and cervicogenic (29%) headaches. Practice-mapping showed technique application varied significantly by professional background, departmental setting, and geographic localization (p = 0.044, p = 0.0012, p < 0.001) rather than headache type.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，手法治疗在头痛管理中广泛应用，但具体技术选择更受专业背景、机构设置和地域实践传统影响，而非标准化、诊断驱动。这提示物理治疗师需要加强证据结合，避免过度依赖区域经验。
items.titleZh: 手法治疗头痛：谁在何处提供何种服务？一项随机对照试验的系统综述与实践映射分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 35 项关于头痛手法治疗的 RCT 进行的系统综述发现，脊柱手法是主要技术（60%），主要应用于紧张性头痛（40%）和颈源性头痛（29%）。实践映射显示，技术应用因专业背景、部门设置和地理位置（p = 0.044, p = 0.0012, p < 0.001）而异，而非头痛类型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that manual techniques are widely used in headache management, but specific technique selection is more influenced by professional background, institutional setting, and regional practice traditions, rather than standardized, diagnosis-driven approaches. This suggests physical therapists need to strengthen evidence integration and avoid over-reliance on regional experience.
items.limitation: 该综述主要侧重于实践映射分析，未对各种手法治疗的实际疗效进行深入评价。
items.limitationEn: The review primarily focused on practice-mapping analysis and did not deeply evaluate the actual efficacy of various manual therapy techniques.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Physiotherapists' experiences of managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 14 UK physiotherapists revealed challenges in managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease, including perceived inadequate assessment tools, limited evidence, and systemic constraints, despite sophisticated clinical reasoning.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了物理治疗师在处理帕金森病患者转弯困难时面临的挑战，包括评估工具不足和缺乏基于证据的协议。这突出说明了该领域需要更系统化的评估方法和治疗指南。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师管理帕金森病转弯困难的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 名英国物理治疗师进行的定性研究揭示了管理帕金森病转弯困难的挑战，包括评估工具不足、证据有限和系统性制约，尽管临床推理复杂。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights challenges physical therapists face when managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease, including inadequate assessment tools and a lack of evidence-based protocols. This underscores the need for more systematic assessment methods and treatment guidelines in this area.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果基于少数物理治疗师的感知和经验，不代表客观证据或普遍实践。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study's findings are based on the perceptions and experiences of a small number of physical therapists, not objective evidence or universal practice.

items.title: Effects of an exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) on physical function in community-dwelling older adults: protocol for a single-centre, assessor-blinded, parallel-group randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This single-center, assessor-blinded, parallel-group RCT protocol aims to evaluate an AI-based exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) in 142 community-dwelling older adults in Beijing over 8 weeks, compared to a standardized program, with the primary outcome being a composite physical function Z-score.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项RCT协议，提示我们未来可能会有基于AI的个性化运动处方系统（ACTIVE）可用于社区老年人。如果这项研究证明其有效，这将在居家运动管理和提升依从性方面提供可扩展的辅助工具。
items.titleZh: 运动处方系统（ACTIVE）对社区老年人身体功能影响的随机对照试验方案：单中心、评估者盲法、平行组研究
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心、评估者盲法、平行组随机对照试验方案旨在评估一项基于 AI 的运动处方系统（ACTIVE）对 142 名北京社区老年人 8 周干预后的身体功能影响，主要结局指标是综合身体功能 Z 值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol suggests a future AI-based personalized exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) for community-dwelling older adults. If proven effective, this could offer a scalable tool for home exercise management and adherence, but for now, it's just a protocol.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未发布最终结果，且为单中心研究，结果外推性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet available. Being a single-center study, the generalizability of its findings remains to be verified.

items.title: Defining Constructs of Hand Function Quality at Home After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury Through Egocentric Videos: A Qualitative Inquiry
items.summary: A qualitative study using focus groups (N=17) identified 14 categories and 33 constructs to describe the quality of hand function in unconstrained, in-home activities after cervical spinal cord injury (cSCI), captured through egocentric videos.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究通过以自我为中心视角视频，定义了颈脊髓损伤（cSCI）患者居家环境中手功能质量的构建要素。这有助于物理治疗师更全面地评估患者真实世界中的手功能，从而制定更贴合实际的康复目标。
items.titleZh: 通过以自我为中心视角视频定义颈脊髓损伤后居家手功能质量的构建要素：一项定性探究
items.summaryZh: 一项通过焦点小组（N=17）进行的定性研究，通过以自我为中心视角视频，确定了 14 个类别和 33 个构建要素，用于描述颈脊髓损伤（cSCI）后居家非受限活动中手功能的质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study, using egocentric videos, defined constructs for hand function quality at home after cervical spinal cord injury (cSCI). This helps physical therapists more comprehensively assess patients' real-world hand function, leading to more practical rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，结果基于焦点小组的感知和讨论，不直接提供量化的干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study; its findings are based on focus group perceptions and discussions, not direct quantitative intervention effects.

items.title: Validity and Reliability of the Performanz Spark for Measuring Sprint Performance in Young Male Basketball Players
items.summary: This study evaluated the validity and reliability of the Performanz Spark device for measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players, providing support for its use in athletic assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 Performanz Spark 设备在测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现方面的有效性和可靠性。这对于运动康复领域的物理治疗师和体能教练评估运动员进展、优化训练方案提供了工具支持。
items.titleZh: Performanz Spark 测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现的有效性和可靠性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了 Performanz Spark 设备测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现的有效性和可靠性，为其在运动评估中的应用提供了支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validated the Performanz Spark device for measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players. This provides tool support for physical therapists and strength coaches in sports rehabilitation to assess athlete progress and optimize training programs.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于年轻男性篮球运动员，结果的通用性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were limited to young male basketball players, which may limit the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: CMS Proposes Reforms to Strengthen Competition, Elevate Care Quality, and Expand Beneficiary Choice in Medicare Advantage
items.summary: CMS is proposing reforms to strengthen competition, elevate care quality, and expand beneficiary choice within the Medicare Advantage (MA) program, which could impact future service provision and reimbursement for MA patients.
items.curatedReason: CMS 正在提议改革 Medicare Advantage (MA) 计划，旨在加强竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择。虽然细节仍待最终确定，但这些变化可能会影响你未来为 MA 患者提供的服务范围和报销模式，务必密切关注最终规则的发布。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 CMS 提议改革以加强 Medicare Advantage 竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择
items.summaryZh: CMS 正在提议改革 Medicare Advantage (MA) 计划，旨在加强竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择，这可能会影响未来 MA 患者的服务提供和报销模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is proposing reforms to Medicare Advantage (MA) plans, aiming to enhance competition, improve care quality, and expand beneficiary choice. While details are pending, these changes could affect the scope of services and reimbursement models for your MA patients, so closely monitor the final rule's release.

items.title: Contract Year 2028 Policy and Technical Changes to the Medicare Advantage Program, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program, and Medicare Cost Plan Program (CMS-4214-P2)
items.summary: CMS has released proposed policy and technical changes for the Contract Year 2028 Medicare Advantage Program, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program, and Medicare Cost Plan Program (CMS-4214-P2), which could impact physical therapy service provision and reimbursement in the US market.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了 2028 年合同年度 Medicare Advantage (MA) 和 Medicare 处方药福利计划的政策和技术修改拟议规则。这些拟议规则可能会影响你在美国市场向 MA 患者提供物理治疗服务的合规性、报销和运营模式，请务必详细审阅并准备提交意见。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 2028 合同年度 Medicare Advantage 计划、Medicare 处方药福利计划和 Medicare 费用计划的政策与技术修改 (CMS-4214-P2)
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了 2028 年合同年度 Medicare Advantage 计划、Medicare 处方药福利计划和 Medicare 费用计划（CMS-4214-P2）的政策和技术修改拟议规则，这可能影响美国市场物理治疗服务的提供和报销。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released proposed policy and technical changes for the Contract Year 2028 Medicare Advantage (MA) and Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Programs. These proposed rules may impact the compliance, reimbursement, and operational models for your physical therapy services to MA patients in the US market, so review them thoroughly and prepare to submit comments.

items.title: State Advocacy for Imaging Orders by Physical Therapist
items.summary: APTA has published resources for state chapters to advocate for physical therapists' authority to order imaging studies, providing background on current regulations, links to state laws where this is permitted, and model legislative language for advocacy efforts in the US.
items.curatedReason: APTA 已发布关于物理治疗师影像检查医嘱权的州级倡议资源。如果你在美国执业，务必了解你所在州的具体法律，因为各州规定差异很大。这些资源是推动或支持扩大执业范围立法的重要工具。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师影像检查医嘱权的州级倡议 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 发布了州级资源，旨在帮助各州分会倡导物理治疗师开具影像检查医嘱的权力，其中包含当前法规背景、已允许该权限的州法律链接以及用于美国倡议的模型立法语言。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released state advocacy resources concerning physical therapists' (PTs') authority to order imaging studies. If you practice in the US, it's crucial to understand your specific state's laws, as regulations vary significantly. These resources are valuable tools for advancing or supporting legislation to expand your scope of practice.

items.title: A Qualitative Study Investigating Sex Differences in the Needs and Priorities of Lower Limb Prosthesis Users
items.summary: A qualitative study of 18 lower limb prosthesis users (9 female, 9 male) found sex-specific differences across prosthetic fit, physical, and psychosocial experiences, including female-specific challenges with prosthetic fit and ambulation, frustrations with clinicians, and concerns regarding maternity and child-rearing.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究发现，下肢假肢使用者在假肢适配、身体功能和心理社会方面存在显著的性别差异，女性在假肢佩戴、步态挑战、对临床医生的沮丧以及生育和育儿方面有独特需求。这提示你在康复和假肢设计中，必须考虑这些性别特异性因素，以提供更个性化的服务。
items.titleZh: 一项调查下肢假肢使用者需求和优先事项性别差异的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 18 名下肢假肢使用者（9 名女性，9 名男性）的定性研究发现，在假肢适配、身体功能和心理社会经历方面存在性别特异性差异，包括女性在假肢适配和行走方面的独特挑战、对临床医生的沮丧以及对生育和育儿的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study found significant sex differences in prosthetic fit, physical function, and psychosocial aspects among lower limb prosthesis users, with women having unique needs in prosthetic wear, gait challenges, frustration with clinicians, and concerns about maternity and child-rearing. This indicates that you must consider these sex-specific factors in rehabilitation and prosthetic design to provide more personalized services.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（18 名假肢使用者，男女各 9 名），且为定性研究，结果可能不具有普遍代表性；研究依赖自我报告，可能存在主观性。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (18 prosthesis users, 9 male and 9 female) and qualitative nature limit generalizability; relies on self-reported data, which may introduce subjectivity.

items.title: Long-term outcomes following non-operative treatment of grade II and III medial collateral ligament injuries with and without concomitant ACL injury
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=154 patients) with a mean 11.5-year follow-up found that non-operatively managed Grade II and III medial collateral ligament (MCL) injuries, with or without concomitant ACL injury, had comparable patient-reported and radiographic outcomes, except for a lower Tegner activity scale in Grade III MCL/ACL injuries.
items.curatedReason: 这项长期随访研究显示，非手术治疗的 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤（无论是否合并 ACL 损伤）患者，其患者报告结局和影像学结果差异不大。这意味着你在临床中，对于孤立性 MCL III 级损伤，可以更有信心地采用非手术治疗方案，但对合并 ACL 损伤的 III 级 MCL 患者，仍需注意其 Tegner 活动评分可能较低。
items.titleZh: 非手术治疗 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带损伤（伴或不伴前交叉韧带损伤）的长期结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 154 名患者进行平均 11.5 年随访的前瞻性队列研究发现，非手术治疗的 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤（无论是否合并前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤），其患者报告结局和影像学结果具有可比性，但 III 级 MCL 合并 ACL 损伤的 Tegner 活动评分较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This long-term follow-up study shows that non-operatively treated Grade II and III medial collateral ligament (MCL) injuries, with or without concomitant ACL injury, had comparable patient-reported and radiographic outcomes. This implies that you can be more confident in non-operative management for isolated Grade III MCL injuries in your practice, but should still note the potentially lower Tegner activity scale for Grade III MCL injuries with concomitant ACL injury.
items.limitation: 观察性队列研究，不能完全排除混杂因素；尽管是长期随访，但一些子组的样本量可能相对较小，影响统计效力。
items.limitationEn: Observational cohort study, which cannot entirely exclude confounding factors; despite long-term follow-up, some subgroup sample sizes may be relatively small, affecting statistical power.

items.title:
Feasibility, safety, and preliminary effects of haptic cane-assisted gait training in chronic hemiparetic stroke: a pilot randomized crossover trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A pilot randomized crossover trial (n=20) in chronic hemiparetic stroke patients found haptic cane-assisted gait training to be feasible and safe, with 97.1% adherence and no adverse events. However, it showed no additional improvement in self-selected gait speed (adjusted between-treatment difference –0.009 m/s, 95% CI –0.032 to 0.013; p = 0.41) compared to conventional gait training.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步随机交叉试验显示，触觉手杖辅助步态训练在慢性偏瘫性卒中患者中是可行且安全的，但其步速改善效果并未优于剂量匹配的常规步态训练。在将触觉手杖纳入常规实践之前，你需要等待更多研究评估其更深层的机制性结局。
items.titleZh: 触觉手杖辅助步态训练在慢性偏瘫性卒中中的可行性、安全性及初步效果：一项试点随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 20 名慢性偏瘫性卒中患者进行的试点随机交叉试验发现，触觉手杖辅助步态训练可行且安全，依从性达 97.1%，无不良事件。然而，与常规步态训练相比，其在自主选择步速方面未显示额外改善（经调整的治疗间差异 –0.009 m/s, 95% CI –0.032 至 0.013; p = 0.41）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot randomized crossover trial indicates that haptic cane-assisted gait training is feasible and safe for chronic hemiparetic stroke patients, but it did not provide additional improvement in gait speed over dose-matched conventional gait training. Before integrating haptic canes into routine practice, you should await further studies evaluating outcomes more closely aligned with its proposed mechanism.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点随机交叉试验，样本量较小（n=20），结果的普遍性有限；研究发现两种干预方案在步速上无显著差异，但可能对其他未测结局存在影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized crossover trial with a small sample size (n=20), limiting generalizability; it found no significant difference in gait speed between interventions, but other unmeasured outcomes might be affected.

items.title: Effect of the timing and setting of pulmonary rehabilitation on functional recovery after lung cancer surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (1137 patients) found late-phase pulmonary rehabilitation significantly improved 6-min walk distance (MD = 68.86 m, 95% CI 53.46-84.26) and VO2peak (MD = 2.62 ml/kg/min, 95% CI 2.08-3.15) after lung cancer surgery. Early in-hospital rehabilitation showed no significant short-term benefits. Fully and partially supervised modes did not differ significantly in 6MWD.
items.curatedReason: 肺癌术后，晚期肺康复是关键，能显著提高患者的 6 分钟步行距离（增加 68.86 米）和 VO2peak。别指望早期住院康复有短期奇效，而且部分监督和全程监督模式对 6MWD 效果相当，你有更多选择空间。
items.titleZh: 肺癌术后肺康复时机与设置对功能恢复的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含随机对照试验（1137 例患者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，肺癌术后晚期肺康复显著改善了 6 分钟步行距离（均差 = 68.86 m, 95% CI 53.46-84.26）和峰值摄氧量（均差 = 2.62 ml/kg/min, 95% CI 2.08-3.15）。早期住院康复未显示显著的短期益处。完全监督和部分监督模式在 6 分钟步行距离上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: After lung cancer surgery, late-phase pulmonary rehabilitation is crucial, significantly improving patients' 6-minute walk distance (by 68.86 m) and VO2peak. Don't expect early in-hospital rehabilitation to show significant short-term benefits, and partially supervised modes are comparable to fully supervised ones for 6MWD, giving you more flexibility.
items.limitation: 不同研究间存在一定异质性，对结果的解释需考虑具体康复方案和患者人群差异。
items.limitationEn: Some heterogeneity exists between studies, so results must be interpreted considering specific rehabilitation protocols and patient population differences.

items.title: Response to letter to the editor regarding 'barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study'.
items.summary: This article is a response to a letter to the editor regarding a qualitative study on barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty. It does not present new data or findings.
items.curatedReason: 这封致编辑的信是对一篇关于全膝关节置换术后老年患者家庭康复决策障碍和促进因素的定性研究的回应。它没有提供新的研究结果或实践指导，但可能有助于理解该研究的背景或方法论。
items.titleZh: 对《全膝关节置换术后老年人居家康复锻炼决策中的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究》致编辑的信的回应。
items.summaryZh: 本文是对一封致编辑的信的回应，该信涉及一项关于全膝关节置换术后老年人居家康复锻炼决策中的障碍与促进因素的定性研究。本文未呈现新的数据或研究结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter to the editor responds to a qualitative study on barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise for older adults post-total knee arthroplasty. It offers no new findings or practice guidance but may provide context for the original study's methodology or background.

items.title: General Archives - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: The BJSM blog provides recent insights into sports medicine, including articles on hamstring strain injuries, traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders, Achilles tendon rupture management, concussion exams, exercise for heart health, and tendinopathy exercise prescription.
items.curatedReason: 这份 BJSM 博文合集确实内容广泛，涵盖从腘绳肌损伤到脑震荡评估等多个热门话题。虽然是博客形式，并非原始研究，但它能让你快速掌握当前运动医学的讨论热点，并可能引导你找到更深入的近期 BJSM 论文。
items.titleZh: BJSM 博客一般文章存档
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客提供了运动医学的最新见解，包括关于腘绳肌拉伤、用于肌肉骨骼疾病的传统中医练习、跟腱断裂管理、脑震荡检查、心脏健康锻炼和肌腱病运动处方等文章。
items.curatedReasonEn: This BJSM blog collection offers a broad, relevant overview of current hot topics in sports medicine, from hamstring injuries to concussion assessment. While not original research, it's a good starting point for quickly grasping current discussions and might direct you to recent, more in-depth BJSM papers.

items.title: The clinical reasoning associated with prognosis and musculoskeletal disorders - A Masterclass in incorporating prognostic reasoning into physiotherapy practice.
items.summary: This masterclass article outlines a practical framework for physiotherapists to incorporate clinical reasoning associated with prognosis into their management of musculoskeletal disorders, aiming to optimize patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本篇「大师班」文章深入探讨了预后判断在骨科物理治疗中的核心地位，提供了一个实用的框架，指导你如何将预后思维融入临床实践，优化患者结局。
items.titleZh: 与预后和肌肉骨骼疾病相关的临床推理——将预后推理纳入物理治疗实践的大师班课程
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师班文章为物理治疗师提供了一个实用框架，旨在将预后相关的临床推理融入肌肉骨骼疾病管理中，以优化患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This "Masterclass" article delves into the core role of prognostic reasoning in orthopedic physical therapy, providing a practical framework to guide you in integrating prognosis into your clinical practice to optimize patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 本篇为专家意见，而非基于原创研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert opinion article, not based on original research data.

items.title: Physiatry-physiotherapy interdisciplinary project (PHY 2 ): Service evaluation of a new caregiving model for musculoskeletal pain by advanced practice physiotherapists in the physiatry department.
items.summary: A single-center prospective descriptive cohort study (n=300) found that Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) independently managed 41% of musculoskeletal pain patients without physiatry consultation, reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 对于常见肌肉骨骼疼痛，高级执业物理治疗师（APP）可以独立承担近一半的患者管理工作（41%），并且可以有效缩短等待时间、提高患者满意度。在你的机构中，可以考虑更大力度地授权APP来管理这类患者，提升效率。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗-理疗科多学科项目 (PHY2)：高级执业物理治疗师在理疗科为肌肉骨骼疼痛患者提供新照护模式的服务评估
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究（n=300）发现，高级执业物理治疗师（APPs）独立管理了41%的肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，无需理疗师会诊，同时缩短了等待时间并提高了患者满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) can independently manage almost half (41%) of common musculoskeletal pain patients, effectively reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction. Consider empowering APPs more robustly in your clinic to manage these patients, which could significantly boost efficiency.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究，且缺乏对照组，结果推广性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective descriptive cohort study without a control group, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: [Correspondence] The F-words for Child Development: Lessons Learned
items.summary: The creators of the "F-words for Child Development" framework thank Wilson et al. for their advocacy, fully endorsing the expanded set of ideas regarding disability, which includes function, family, fitness, fun, and future.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通信是对“儿童发育 F 词框架”的再次肯定，它强调了功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来等因素在儿童残疾康复中的核心作用。这为你理解以家庭为中心、以功能为导向的儿童康复理念提供了进一步支持。
items.titleZh: 儿童发育 F 词：经验教训
items.summaryZh: “儿童发育 F 词”框架的创建者们感谢 Wilson 及其同事对该理念的推广，并完全认可这一扩展的残疾概念集合，其中包括功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence reaffirms the "F-words for Child Development" framework, emphasizing the central role of function, family, fitness, fun, and future in pediatric disability rehabilitation. It provides further support for your understanding of family-centered, function-oriented pediatric rehabilitation concepts.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (n=48) found that both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback-guided core training significantly reduced pain and disability in chronic mechanical low back pain patients after four weeks compared to an advice-only control. Suspension core training showed additional benefits over pressure biofeedback in lumbar extension ROM and core muscle endurance, but not in pain intensity or flexion ROM.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性机械性腰痛，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练都能在短期内减轻疼痛和改善功能。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展 ROM 和核心耐力方面可能优于压力生物反馈，但并非所有结果都一致。
items.titleZh: 悬吊核心训练与压力生物反馈训练对慢性机械性腰痛的疗效：一项三臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=48）显示，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练在慢性机械性腰痛患者中均能在四周后显著减轻疼痛和改善功能残疾。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展活动度（ROM）和核心肌耐力方面优于压力生物反馈，但在疼痛强度或屈曲 ROM 上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic mechanical low back pain, both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback core training significantly reduce pain and improve function short-term compared to advice alone. Suspension core training may offer additional benefits in lumbar extension ROM and core endurance over pressure biofeedback, though not consistently across all outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小、干预期短且无随访数据，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size, short intervention period, and lack of follow-up warrant cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Sensor-based motion analysis identifies distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories following internal fixation and arthroplasty: a retrospective longitudinal cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=228) using sensor-based motion analysis identified a limited subset of 12 measures with FDR-supported differences in biomechanical recovery trajectories over 200 postoperative days between hip internal fixation and arthroplasty patients. These included balance, gait, chair-stand, kinematic, and patient-reported variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，髋关节内固定与关节置换术后早期恢复的生物力学轨迹存在差异。在临床实践中，您可以根据患者的术式和诊断，考虑使用传感器数据来监测其个性化康复进程。
items.titleZh: 髋关节内固定与关节置换术后生物力学恢复轨迹的传感器分析：一项回顾性纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=228）使用传感器运动分析，在髋关节内固定和关节置换术后200天内，识别出12项指标在生物力学恢复轨迹上存在显著差异，包括平衡、步态、起立坐下、运动学和患者自评变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories post-hip internal fixation versus arthroplasty. In clinical practice, you might consider using sensor-based data to monitor individualized rehabilitation progress, tailored to the patient's surgical procedure and diagnosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性探索性队列研究，且未获取康复暴露数据，其发现具有关联性而非因果性，需在诊断特异性队列中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective exploratory cohort study lacked rehabilitation exposure data, making its findings associative rather than causal; external validation in diagnosis-specific cohorts is required.

items.title:
Satisfaction with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation in people with Parkinson's disease and its association with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life: a longitudinal national register study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A longitudinal national register study (n=173) of Parkinson's disease patients found that over 82% were satisfied with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation. High satisfaction was associated with higher life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge, with broader associations observed in men and older adults (>69 years).
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者对院外康复的满意度与出院时的生活满意度和健康相关生命质量正相关。在评估和优化康复方案时，您应关注患者的康复体验和患者报告结局，尤其对男性和老年患者，这种关联更为显著。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者对医院门诊康复的满意度及其与生活满意度和健康相关生命质量的关联：一项纵向国家登记研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对173名帕金森病患者的纵向国家登记研究发现，超过82%的患者对医院门诊康复感到满意。高满意度与出院时的更高生活满意度和健康相关生命质量相关，其中男性和老年患者（>69岁）的关联更广泛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patient satisfaction with outpatient rehabilitation for Parkinson's disease is positively associated with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge. When evaluating and optimizing rehabilitation programs, you should consider patients' experiences and patient-reported outcomes, especially as this association is more pronounced in men and older adults.
items.limitation: 本研究为国家登记研究，依赖自我报告问卷数据，可能存在报告偏差，且未能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This national register study relied on self-reported questionnaire data, which may introduce reporting bias, and could not establish causality.

related.title: Satisfaction with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation in people with Parkinson's disease and its association with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life: a longitudinal national register study.

items.title: Force and Power Testing in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Literature: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review of 1625 studies on force and power testing post-ACLR identified significant heterogeneity in device selection, metrics, and protocols. Isokinetic dynamometry (64.9%) remained the most adopted testing device, but assessment practices have become more varied, with studies using 1.42 ± 0.62 devices on average.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试方法的显著异质性。在临床实践中，这意味着您在解读不同研究结果时需注意其评估工具和方案的差异，并考虑结合多种设备进行更全面的评估。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建文献中力量和爆发力测试：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对1625项关于前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试的研究进行的范围综述发现，设备选择、测量指标和方案存在显著异质性。等速测力计（64.9%）仍是最常用的测试设备，但评估实践已变得更加多样化，平均每项研究使用1.42 ± 0.62种设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals significant heterogeneity in force and power testing methods post-ACL reconstruction. In clinical practice, this means you need to account for differences in assessment tools and protocols when interpreting various study results, and consider combining multiple devices for a more comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，侧重于现有文献的总结和描述，未进行质量评估和综合分析。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review focused on synthesizing and describing existing literature, without conducting quality assessment or comprehensive analysis.

items.title: Unpacking what works in home rehabilitation in relation to contexts, mechanisms, and outcomes in a qualitative scoping review
items.summary: A qualitative scoping review of 62 studies identified three categories (professional knowledge and approach, home and everyday life, focus on personalization) of contextual factors and mechanisms influencing outcomes in home rehabilitation for older adults. These factors shape resources and reasoning contributing to rehabilitation outcomes from the perspectives of older adults, relatives, and staff.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性范围综述识别了影响老年人居家康复效果的关键情境因素和机制。在设计居家康复服务时，您应关注个性化、专业知识、沟通以及家庭与日常生活的整合，以实现以人为本的服务。
items.titleZh: 定性范围综述：剖析居家康复中情境、机制和结果的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对62项研究进行的定性范围综述识别出影响老年人居家康复结果的情境因素和机制的三个类别（专业知识与方法、居家与日常生活、关注个性化）。这些因素从老年人、家属和医护人员的角度，塑造了有助于康复结果的资源和推理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative scoping review identifies key contextual factors and mechanisms influencing home rehabilitation outcomes for older adults. When designing home rehabilitation services, you should focus on personalization, professional expertise, communication, and the integration of home and daily life to achieve person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本范围综述仅纳入定性研究，未能提供居家康复干预的量化效果或证据等级。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review included only qualitative studies, providing no quantitative effects or evidence levels for home rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Chart-derived frailty index is associated with long-term mortality and longitudinal health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a prospective cohort (n=1072) found that a higher chart-derived frailty index (CFI) was associated with increased mortality (adjusted HR 2.621) and poorer health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults. Exploratory analyses also suggested poorer long-term walking ability and mobility in the high-CFI group.
items.curatedReason: 图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）与髋部骨折老年患者的长期死亡率和健康相关生命质量相关。在术后康复管理中，您可以利用CFI作为评估工具，识别高风险患者，并可能调整康复计划以改善预后。
items.titleZh: 图表衍生衰弱指数与髋部骨折老年患者长期死亡率和纵向健康相关生命质量的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究的次级分析
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=1072）的次级分析发现，髋部骨折老年患者的图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）较高者，与更高的死亡率（调整后HR 2.621）和较差的健康相关生命质量相关。探索性分析还提示高CFI组的长期步行能力和活动能力较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: The chart-derived frailty index (CFI) is associated with long-term mortality and health-related quality of life in older adults with hip fractures. In postoperative rehabilitation management, you can use CFI as an assessment tool to identify high-risk patients and potentially adjust rehabilitation plans to improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列的次级分析，对纵向轨迹差异的证据受模型设定影响，且功能结局分析为探索性。
items.limitationEn: This secondary analysis of a prospective cohort found evidence for different longitudinal trajectories sensitive to model specification, and functional outcome analyses were exploratory.

items.title: Psychological readiness, active knee flexion and patient-reported knee function at 12 and 18 months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study (n=75) on ACLR patients found that higher psychological readiness (ACL-RSI) was associated with higher concurrent patient-reported knee function (Lysholm score) at 12 and 18 months post-surgery. Active knee flexion increased by 4.00° (95% CI, 3.15°–4.85°; P < 0.001) but was not significantly associated with Lysholm score.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在前交叉韧带重建术后，患者的心理准备状态与患者自评膝关节功能存在正相关。在术后评估中，您除了关注身体功能指标外，还应将心理准备状态纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后12和18个月的心理准备状态、膝关节主动屈曲和患者自评膝关节功能：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，术后12和18个月，较高的心理准备状态（ACL-RSI）与较高的患者自评膝关节功能（Lysholm评分）相关。主动膝关节屈曲增加了4.00°（95% CI，3.15°–4.85%；P < 0.001），但与Lysholm评分无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a positive association between psychological readiness and patient-reported knee function after ACL reconstruction. In postoperative assessment, you should consider psychological readiness alongside physical function measures.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，样本量小，未建立因果关系，且对随访期间关联差异的评估不精确。
items.limitationEn: This single-center retrospective cohort study had a small sample size, did not establish causality, and its assessment of association differences over follow-up was imprecise.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in Women Who Practice CrossFit®: A Systematic Review
items.summary: This systematic review of 16 cross-sectional and two case-control studies investigated pelvic floor dysfunction prevalence in female CrossFit practitioners. It found urinary incontinence rates from 14.5% to 84%, with longer CrossFit practice, higher intensity, and jump rope exercises associated with increased risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的高患病率，特别是尿失禁。它指出了训练时间、强度和高冲击练习（如跳绳）与症状之间的关联，提示临床医生应在为从事这类运动的女性提供咨询时考虑这些风险因素。
items.titleZh: CrossFit® 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率及相关因素：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述纳入了 16 项横断面研究和 2 项病例对照研究，调查了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率。结果显示，尿失禁的患病率从 14.5% 到 84% 不等，且 CrossFit 训练时间越长、强度越高以及跳绳练习与风险增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights the high prevalence of pelvic floor dysfunction, particularly urinary incontinence, among women who practice CrossFit. It points to associations between longer practice duration, higher intensity, and high-impact exercises like jump rope, suggesting clinicians should consider these risk factors when counseling women engaged in such sports.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究多为横断面设计，难以确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were predominantly cross-sectional, making it difficult to establish causality.

items.title: Does whole-body electromyostimulation improve functional, compositional, and biochemical outcomes in older women with sarcopenia? A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This open-label RCT of 30 sarcopenic older women found 8 weeks of whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) significantly improved balance, handgrip strength, functional capacity, body composition (reduced body weight/BMI/fat, increased skeletal muscle mass), and myokine levels (decreased myostatin, increased follistatin) compared to controls. The trial was retrospectively registered.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）在肌少症老年女性中能改善身体功能、身体成分和肌因子水平。对于无法进行常规阻力训练的患者，WB-EMS 可能是一个时间高效的替代方案，但需等待更大规模、更高质量的研究验证。
items.titleZh: 全身电肌肉刺激能否改善肌少症老年女性的功能、身体成分和生化结局？一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项对 30 名肌少症老年女性进行的开放标签随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，8 周的全身电肌肉刺激 (WB-EMS) 显著改善了平衡、握力、功能能力、身体成分（体重/BMI/脂肪减少，骨骼肌质量增加）和肌因子水平（肌抑素减少，卵泡抑素增加）。本试验为回顾性注册。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) can improve physical function, body composition, and myokine levels in sarcopenic older women. For patients unable to perform conventional resistance training, WB-EMS might be a time-efficient alternative, but validation from larger, higher-quality studies is needed.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签试验，未进行分配隐藏和结局评估盲法，可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was an open-label trial without allocation concealment and blinded outcome assessment, which may introduce bias.

items.title: Strength Training in Youth: A Scoping Review with Evidence Gap Map
items.summary: This scoping review of 342 studies on youth strength training (6–18 years) found 90% assessed physical performance, with limited focus on motor competence, injury prevention, or psychosocial factors. Key gaps include under-representation of female participants, scarce studies on biologically mature adolescents, and lack of long-term follow-up beyond 6 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述发现，青少年力量训练的研究主要集中在身体表现上，但在女性参与者、生物成熟度评估、长期随访和心理社会结局方面存在显著差距。这提醒临床医师在为青少年制定训练方案时，需关注这些研究盲区。
items.titleZh: 青少年力量训练：一项带证据差距地图的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 342 项青少年力量训练（6-18 岁）研究的范围综述发现，90% 的研究评估了身体表现，而对运动能力、损伤预防或社会心理因素的关注有限。主要空白包括女性参与者不足、对生物成熟青少年研究稀缺以及缺乏超过 6 个月的长期随访。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found that youth strength training research predominantly focuses on physical performance, with significant gaps in female representation, biological maturation assessment, long-term follow-up, and psychosocial outcomes. This highlights critical blind spots for clinicians when designing training programs for young athletes.
items.limitation: 本综述识别的是证据空白，而非提供训练实践的确定性建议。
items.limitationEn: This review identifies evidence gaps rather than providing definitive recommendations for training practice.

items.title: Effects of Functional Visuo-Proprioceptive Stimulation on Upper- and Lower-Limb Motor Impairment After Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Crossover Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled crossover trial (N=21) found that functional visuo-proprioceptive stimulation (FPS) was associated with reduced upper-limb (7.22 points FMA-UE improvement) and lower-limb (2.23 points FMA-LE improvement) motor impairment in individuals with subacute stroke, with upper-limb gains reaching clinically important difference ranges.
items.curatedReason: 功能性视觉本体感受刺激（FPS）可能成为亚急性卒中患者康复的有效辅助手段。这项 RCT 证明了其对肢体运动障碍的改善，尤其是上肢，效果可达临床最小重要差异范围。
items.titleZh: 功能性视觉本体感受刺激对卒中后上肢和下肢运动障碍的影响：一项随机对照交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照交叉试验（N=21）发现，功能性视觉本体感受刺激（FPS）与亚急性卒中患者上肢（FMA-UE 改善 7.22 分）和下肢（FMA-LE 改善 2.23 分）运动障碍的减轻相关，其中上肢的改善达到了临床重要差异范围。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional visuo-proprioceptive stimulation (FPS) could be an effective adjunct in subacute stroke rehabilitation. This RCT demonstrates its improvements in limb motor impairment, particularly for the upper extremity, reaching the minimal clinically important difference range.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心交叉随机对照试验，样本量相对较小（21名完成者），且未评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center, crossover RCT with a relatively small sample size (21 completers) and did not assess long-term effects.

items.title: Compensatory Trunk Neuromuscular Control During Early Rehabilitation After Motor Incomplete Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: This observational study of 36 individuals with motor incomplete SCI found that trunk neuromuscular control strategies during early rehabilitation (4 weeks) differ based on injury severity, with more severe injuries showing greater caudal shifts in lumbar erector spinae activation patterns.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，脊髓不完全损伤后的躯干神经肌肉控制恢复策略，会因损伤严重程度而异。它支持在早期康复中，结合详细的躯干运动学和高密度表面肌电图来指导更个体化的干预。
items.titleZh: 运动不完全性脊髓损伤早期康复期间的代偿性躯干神经肌肉控制
items.summaryZh: 这项对 36 名运动不完全性脊髓损伤患者的观察性研究发现，早期（4 周）康复期间的躯干神经肌肉控制策略因损伤严重程度而异，其中损伤较重的患者在腰骶竖脊肌激活模式上表现出更大的尾侧偏移。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that trunk neuromuscular control recovery strategies after motor incomplete SCI vary by injury severity. It supports incorporating detailed trunk kinematics and HDsEMG in early rehabilitation to guide more individualized interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项短期（4周随访）的观察性研究，样本量相对较小（36名SCI患者），结论外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a short-term (4-week follow-up) observational study with a relatively small sample size (36 SCI participants), limiting generalizability.

items.title: The effect of music therapy on function in people with Parkinson's disease or parkinsonism: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies (3635 patients) found music therapy significantly improved athletic function (SMD = -0.53), balance (SMD = 0.45), gait (SMD = 0.59), depression (SMD = -0.76), anxiety (SMD = -0.59), sleep quality (SMD = -0.76), cognitive function (SMD = -0.90), and swallowing function (SMD = -1.35) in people with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这份大样本系统综述和荟萃分析确证了音乐疗法对帕金森病患者运动功能、平衡、步态以及抑郁、焦虑、睡眠、认知和吞咽功能有显著改善。这些效应量均达到临床意义，表明音乐疗法应被纳入帕金森病的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 音乐疗法对帕金森病或帕金森综合征患者功能的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，音乐疗法显著改善了帕金森病患者的运动功能 (SMD = -0.53)、平衡 (SMD = 0.45)、步态 (SMD = 0.59)，以及抑郁 (SMD = -0.76)、焦虑 (SMD = -0.59)、睡眠质量 (SMD = -0.76)、认知功能 (SMD = -0.90) 和吞咽功能 (SMD = -1.35)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that music therapy significantly improves motor function, balance, gait, depression, anxiety, sleep, cognition, and swallowing in Parkinson's disease patients. The effect sizes are clinically meaningful, indicating music therapy should be integrated into Parkinson's rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的普遍质量良好，但未提及是否存在异质性或出版偏倚对效应量的影响。
items.limitationEn: While the included studies are generally of good quality, the review did not explicitly state the impact of heterogeneity or publication bias on the effect sizes.

items.title: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.5-24 hours) for acute ischemic stroke found IVT significantly increased the odds of 90-day mRS 0-1 (OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72). It also increased early neurological improvement (OR 1.59) but did not significantly improve 90-day mRS 0-2.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 8 个 RCT、2548 名患者的荟萃分析明确指出，在急性缺血性卒中发作 4.5 至 24 小时内进行静脉溶栓（IVT），可显著提高患者 90 天良好功能预后（mRS 0-1）的几率（OR 1.45）。你可以更有信心地考虑为符合条件的、处于延长时间窗的患者推荐 IVT 治疗。
items.titleZh: 急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗溶栓（4.5-24 小时）：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8 项急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗静脉溶栓（4.5-24 小时）随机对照试验（n=2548）的荟萃分析发现，静脉溶栓显著增加了 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-1 分的几率（OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72）。它也增加了早期神经功能改善（OR 1.59），但对 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-2 分无显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis of 8 RCTs, involving 2548 patients, clearly indicates that intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) administered 4.5 to 24 hours after acute ischemic stroke onset significantly increases the odds of excellent functional outcome (mRS 0-1) at 90 days (OR 1.45). You can recommend IVT with more confidence for eligible patients within the extended time window.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析主要基于汇总数据，且纳入试验中大部分使用了组织不匹配影像学筛选患者，可能限制结果对所有卒中患者的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis primarily used aggregate data, and most included trials used tissue mismatch imaging for patient selection, which may limit the generalizability of results to all stroke patients.

items.title: Diagnostic Precision in Arthrogenic Muscle Inhibition
items.summary: This current opinion piece argues that arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI) is a specific neurophysiological condition defined by spinal reflex inhibition, not a blanket term for quadriceps dysfunction after knee injury. It advocates for mechanistic confirmation for AMI diagnosis, suggesting descriptive terms like "voluntary activation failure" if mechanisms are not measured.
items.curatedReason: 关节源性肌肉抑制（AMI）的诊断常被滥用，这项观点文章提醒我们，AMI 具有特异的神经生理机制，不应将所有膝关节损伤后的股四头肌功能障碍都归结于此。你必须寻求机制性确认，以避免误导治疗选择。
items.titleZh: 关节源性肌肉抑制的诊断精确性
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，关节源性肌肉抑制（AMI）是一种由脊柱反射抑制定义的特定神经生理状况，并非膝关节损伤后股四头肌功能障碍的统称。文章主张对 AMI 诊断进行机制性确认，如果未测量机制，则建议使用“自主激活失败”等描述性术语。
items.curatedReasonEn: The diagnosis of arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI) is often misused. This opinion piece reminds us that AMI has specific neurophysiological mechanisms, and not all quadriceps dysfunction after knee injury should be attributed to it. You must seek mechanistic confirmation to avoid misdirecting treatment choices.

items.title: Prepaid Physical Therapy Models
items.summary: APTA issued a practice advisory on prepaid physical therapy models (concierge, subscription, bundled services) as of November 2026. These models address persistent payment pressures and administrative burdens, offering alternatives to third-party reimbursement for PT services.
items.curatedReason: 随着支付压力和行政复杂性的增加，预付费物理治疗模式（如礼宾、订阅制、预付费捆绑服务）日益受到关注。APTA 的这份指南为你提供在患者直接支付模式下执业的最新考量，有助于你探索和规划新的营收途径。
items.titleZh: 预付费物理治疗模式 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 于 2026 年 11 月发布了一份关于预付费物理治疗模式（礼宾、订阅、捆绑服务）的执业建议。这些模式旨在应对持续存在的支付压力和行政负担，为物理治疗服务提供第三方报销的替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Amid increasing payment pressures and administrative complexity, prepaid physical therapy models (e.g., concierge, subscription, bundled services) are gaining traction. This APTA advisory offers current considerations for practicing under patient-direct payment models, helping you explore and plan new revenue streams.

items.title: Direct Access By State
items.summary: APTA updated its resource on direct access to physical therapist services in all 50 US states, DC, and the U.S. Virgin Islands, as of November 2026. It outlines the varying levels of direct access provisions and limitations across jurisdictions.
items.curatedReason: 这份 APTA 的最新资源是了解美国各州物理治疗师直接准入法规的权威指南。它直接指出各州对直接准入的规定和限制，对规划你的执业范围、管理患者转诊路径至关重要，你务必查阅你所在州的最新规定。
items.titleZh: 各州直接准入情况 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 更新了截至 2026 年 11 月美国 50 个州、哥伦比亚特区和美属维尔京群岛物理治疗师服务直接准入的资源。它概述了各司法管辖区直接准入规定的不同水平和限制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated APTA resource is the definitive guide to direct access laws for physical therapists across the U.S. It directly outlines each state's provisions and limitations for direct access, which is crucial for planning your scope of practice and managing patient referral pathways. You must consult the latest regulations for your state.

items.title: Association between internal training load and overuse injuries in professional sabre fencers: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=14 fencers, 497 athlete-weeks) found higher cumulative sRPE workload categories (2-week: OR=2.11; 3-week: OR=2.36; 4-week: OR=2.76) were associated with greater odds of subsequent substantial overuse problems in fencers without prior problems.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究发现，职业佩剑运动员累积训练负荷越高，后续周内出现过度使用损伤的几率越大。在制定训练计划时，应密切监测运动员的累积负荷，以预防过度训练。
items.titleZh: 内部训练负荷与职业佩剑运动员过度使用损伤之间的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=14 名击剑运动员，497 个运动员周）发现，在没有前期问题的运动员中，较高的累积 sRPE 训练负荷类别（2 周：OR=2.11；3 周：OR=2.36；4 周：OR=2.76）与后续出现显著过度使用问题的几率增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study found that higher cumulative training loads in professional sabre fencers were associated with greater odds of subsequent overuse injuries. When planning training, you should closely monitor cumulative load to prevent overtraining.
items.limitation: 本研究为单支队伍小样本量（14 名击剑运动员），且未调整混杂因素，不能建立因果关系，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size from a single team (14 fencers) and did not adjust for confounders, thus causality cannot be established, and generalizability is limited.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A robotic neck exoskeleton for children with poor head control: a feasibility study
items.summary: A feasibility study (n=5 children with poor head control) evaluated a robotic neck exoskeleton in a school setting. The system was well-tolerated, improved head control and task performance, and increased the contribution of head twist to overall rotation (from 40.4% to 65.3-66.7%) while maintaining substantial sternocleidomastoid activation.
items.curatedReason: 儿童颈部外骨骼机器人初步验证了其在改善头部控制方面的可行性和即时生物力学效果。这为未来针对严重运动障碍儿童的康复干预提供了新的技术方向，尤其值得你在技术辅助康复领域关注。
items.titleZh: 一种用于头部控制能力差儿童的机器人颈部外骨骼：一项可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项可行性研究（n=5 名头部控制能力差的儿童）评估了在学校环境中使用机器人颈部外骨骼。该系统耐受性良好，改善了头部控制和任务表现，并增加了头部扭转对总体旋转的贡献（从 40.4% 增至 65.3-66.7%），同时保持胸锁乳突肌的显著激活。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study validates the feasibility and immediate biomechanical effects of a robotic neck exoskeleton in improving head control in children. This offers a new technological direction for rehabilitation interventions targeting children with severe motor disabilities, particularly relevant for those focused on technology-assisted rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量极小（N=5），且仅评估了短期即时效果，未能探讨长期使用对发育和功能的全面影响。
