items.limitationEn: This study had an extremely small sample size (N=5) and only evaluated immediate short-term effects, without exploring the comprehensive long-term impact on development and function.

items.title: Prognostic factors and prognostic models for recovery and treatment response in patients with painful cervical radiculopathy: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 7 studies on painful cervical radiculopathy found limited evidence (very low to moderate certainty) for prognostic factors and models. Only one model was internally validated, and none were externally validated, making their clinical implementation unsupported.
items.curatedReason: 对于有症状性颈椎神经根病患者的预后因素和治疗反应预测模型，目前证据仍十分有限且质量较低。在将任何预测模型应用于临床实践前，务必等待外部验证研究。
items.titleZh: 疼痛性颈椎神经根病患者康复和治疗反应的预后因素和预测模型：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 7 项疼痛性颈椎神经根病研究的系统综述发现，预后因素和预测模型的证据有限（确定性极低至中等）。仅有一个模型进行了内部验证，且所有模型均未进行外部验证，因此不支持其临床应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for prognostic factors and predictive models for recovery and treatment response in patients with painful cervical radiculopathy is currently limited and of low quality. You must await external validation studies before implementing any predictive model in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 纳入的七项研究中，大多数存在高风险偏倚，且所有预测模型均未经过外部验证，限制了其临床应用价值。
items.limitationEn: Most of the seven included studies had a high risk of bias, and none of the predictive models were externally validated, limiting their clinical applicability.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra secures first ever conviction for misuse of the title ‘surgeon’
items.summary: Ahpra secured its first conviction against a Sydney cosmetic doctor, Adam Najem, for unlawfully using the title "surgeon" in advertising since national law changes in September 2023. He was sentenced to an eight-month Community Corrections Order and fined $12,000.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 首次成功起诉并定罪冒用“外科医生”头衔的医生。这起案件坐实了澳大利亚在规范医疗执业头衔上的决心，提示你在澳大利亚执业时必须严格遵守头衔使用规定。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——Ahpra 首次成功起诉并定罪冒用“外科医生”头衔者
items.summaryZh: 自 2023 年国家法律修改后，澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 首次成功起诉并定罪悉尼美容医生 Adam Najem，罪名是在广告中非法使用“外科医生”头衔。他被判处八个月社区矫正令并罚款 12,000 澳元。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has successfully prosecuted and convicted a doctor for the first time for misusing the title "surgeon." This case solidifies Australia's commitment to regulating professional titles, reminding you to strictly adhere to title usage regulations when practicing in Australia.

items.title: Reliability and responsiveness of breathing pattern – a narrative review
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes existing literature on the reliability and responsiveness of breathing patterns as a potential outcome measure in respiratory physiotherapy. It highlights the lack of an agreed-upon definition for "breathing pattern" and insufficient validated and reliable outcome measures in the field.
items.curatedReason: 呼吸模式的可靠性和反应性对于呼吸物理治疗的循证实践至关重要。这篇综述提醒我们，目前对呼吸模式的定义和测量方法缺乏统一标准，导致其作为结局指标的临床应用仍存在障碍。
items.titleZh: 呼吸模式的可靠性和反应性——一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了关于呼吸模式作为呼吸物理治疗潜在结局指标的可靠性和反应性文献。它强调了“呼吸模式”定义缺乏共识以及该领域缺乏经过验证且可靠的结局测量工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: The reliability and responsiveness of breathing patterns are crucial for evidence-based respiratory physical therapy. This review highlights that the lack of standardized definitions and measurement methods for breathing patterns currently hinders its clinical utility as an outcome measure.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性文献检索和质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review may have selection bias and did not conduct a systematic literature search or quality assessment.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Improvement in functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance following TRX training in physically active athletes after ACL reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found a 6-week TRX suspension training program significantly improved dynamic balance (e.g., anterior reach: F=33.527, p<0.001), movement quality (FMS scores: F=251.994, p<0.001), and landing mechanics (LESS scores: F=75.385, p<0.001) more than traditional rehabilitation in male athletes after ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 本项随机对照试验明确指出，在ACL重建术后的康复中，TRX悬吊训练比传统康复更能显著改善运动员的功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡。这些结果提示TRX训练作为高级康复阶段的干预手段，应被考虑纳入重返运动前的康复方案，以提升患者的运动表现和安全性。
items.titleZh: ACL重建术后体能活跃运动员TRX训练对功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡的改善：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六周的TRX悬吊训练方案在ACL重建术后的男性运动员中，相比传统康复，显著改善了动态平衡（如前向伸展：F=33.527, p<0.001）、动作质量（FMS评分：F=251.994, p<0.001）和着陆力学（LESS评分：F=75.385, p<0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial clearly indicates that TRX suspension training significantly improves functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance in athletes after ACL reconstruction, outperforming traditional rehabilitation. These results suggest TRX training should be considered for advanced rehabilitation phases before return to sport to enhance patient performance and safety.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短，长期效果和重返运动后再次损伤率未知，且研究对象仅限男性运动员。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period, with unknown long-term effects and re-injury rates after return to sport, and participants were exclusively male athletes.

items.title: Should Nerve Transfer Surgery be the Standard of Care for Cervical Spinal Cord Injury?
items.summary: A critical analysis of the literature highlights nerve transfer surgery as a promising intervention for improving upper limb function following cervical spinal cord injury, with generally positive aggregate outcomes but variable individual responses. It also discusses peri-operative challenges, potential benefits of combining nerve and tendon transfer, and the impact on spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 本述评肯定了神经转移手术在改善脊髓颈段损伤患者上肢功能方面的潜力，但同时强调仍存在知识空白，尤其是在最佳手术时机、康复方案和结局变异性方面。临床实践中，应将神经转移手术视为一种有前景但仍需个体化考量的治疗选项，并在康复中注意结合腱转移和痉挛管理。
items.titleZh: 神经转移手术是否应成为颈脊髓损伤的标准治疗？
items.summaryZh: 一项对文献的批判性分析强调，神经转移手术是改善颈脊髓损伤后上肢功能的有前景的干预措施，总体结局积极但个体反应存在差异。该分析还讨论了围手术期挑战、联合神经和肌腱转移的潜在益处，以及其对痉挛的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary affirms the potential of nerve transfer surgery to improve upper limb function in cervical spinal cord injury patients but also highlights existing knowledge gaps, particularly regarding optimal surgical timing, rehabilitation protocols, and outcome variability. In clinical practice, nerve transfer surgery should be considered a promising but individualized treatment option, with attention to combining tendon transfer and spasticity management in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，基于现有文献进行分析，缺乏新的实证数据支持。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert commentary based on existing literature analysis, lacking new empirical data.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Association of outpatient waiting time with pain intensity and coping strategies in patients with nonspecific chronic low back pain scheduled for physiotherapy.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=60) found outpatient waiting time (OWT) negatively correlated with catastrophizing on arrival (ρ=-0.78, p < .001) in NSCLBP patients. OWT was also associated with patient satisfaction (χ2 = 9.11, p = .028), and while pain increased during OWT, multimodal physiotherapy improved pain and coping strategies.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，门诊等待时间与患者的灾难化思维和婚姻状况相关，并可能影响患者对治疗的满意度。尽管疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗仍能改善疼痛、灾难化思维和再解释策略。这些发现强调了尽量减少门诊物理治疗等待时间的重要性。
items.titleZh: 门诊等待时间与非特异性慢性腰痛物理治疗患者疼痛强度及应对策略的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究（n=60）发现，在非特异性慢性腰痛患者中，门诊等待时间（OWT）与就诊时的灾难化思维呈负相关（ρ=-0.78, p < .001），并与患者满意度相关（χ2 = 9.11, p = .028）。虽然疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗能改善疼痛和应对策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that outpatient waiting time is associated with patients' catastrophizing and marital status, and may impact treatment satisfaction. Although pain intensity may increase during waiting, multimodal physiotherapy can still improve pain, catastrophizing, and reinterpretation. These findings highlight the importance of minimizing delays in outpatient physiotherapy visits.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，样本量较小（n=60），可能存在混杂因素，且仅在一个教学医院进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective observational study with a small sample size (n=60), potential confounding factors, and limited generalizability as it was conducted at a single teaching hospital.

items.title: How do patients, physiotherapists and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation? A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored perceptions of delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty (TKA) rehabilitation among patients (n=6), physiotherapists (n=6), and orthopedic surgeons (n=5). Patients prioritized pain relief, physiotherapists prioritized physical function, and surgeons prioritized patient satisfaction, highlighting differences in identifying delayed recovery and prognostic factors.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生在全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的认知上存在差异。临床实践中需要建立关于何时以及如何将TKA康复视为延迟的共识，并关注患者预期作为潜在的治疗目标，以优化康复结果。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术康复期间，患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生如何看待康复延迟？一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了患者（n=6）、物理治疗师（n=6）和骨科医生（n=5）对全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的看法。研究发现，患者优先关注疼痛缓解，物理治疗师关注身体功能，而外科医生关注患者满意度，揭示了在识别康复延迟和预后因素方面的认知差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals discrepancies in how patients, physiotherapists, and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Clinical practice needs consensus on when and how to consider TKA recovery delayed, with patient expectations as a potential treatment target to optimize rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，且参与者来自特定背景，可能限制了发现的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size and participants from specific backgrounds, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: What do physiotherapists need to effectively integrate a biopsychosocial approach in treatment of patients with non-specific low back pain? A qualitative analysis.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=15 Swiss outpatient physiotherapists) identified four interconnected themes for effectively integrating biopsychosocial approaches in non-specific low back pain treatment: a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration, enhanced educational approaches, and foundational professional attributes.
items.curatedReason: 将生物心理社会方法融入非特异性腰痛治疗，远不只是个人技能问题。这项对15名理疗师的定性研究提示我们，宏观的系统框架、中观的跨学科协作与教育支持，以及微观的专业素质，缺一不可。这意味着推行这一模式时，不能只关注个人培训，更要同步改革系统、促进协作。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师需要什么才能有效整合生物心理社会方法治疗非特异性腰痛？一项定性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对15位瑞士门诊物理治疗师的定性研究，确定了在非特异性腰痛治疗中有效整合生物心理社会方法的四个相互关联主题：支持性系统框架、加强跨学科合作、改进教育方法以及核心专业素质。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating biopsychosocial approaches for non-specific low back pain is more than just an individual skill set. This qualitative study of 15 physiotherapists suggests that a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration and enhanced educational approaches, alongside foundational professional attributes, are all essential. This implies that promoting this model requires systemic and collaborative reforms, not just individual training.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（n=15），且仅针对瑞士门诊物理治疗师，结果的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=15) and was conducted only among Swiss outpatient physiotherapists, so the generalizability of the findings needs further validation.

items.title: Therapy Performance Predicts Functional Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: Therapy performance metrics (TPMs) extracted from clinical notes using machine learning predict functional discharge outcomes in stroke patients (n=42) as early as 5-7 days post-admission, with R² values of 0.64-0.78 for 10MWT, 6MWT, and BBS. Incorporating TPMs improved 6MWT prediction from R²=0.30 to 0.63, reducing error by ~25 m.
items.curatedReason: 本研究利用机器学习从临床笔记中提取治疗表现指标（TPMs），大幅提升了卒中患者出院功能恢复的早期预测能力。这提示未来可通过常规临床数据实现更动态、实时的康复预测和个性化方案调整。
items.titleZh: 治疗表现指标预测卒中后功能恢复
items.summaryZh: 一项对42名卒中患者的观察研究显示，从临床笔记中提取的治疗表现指标（TPMs）可早在入院后5-7天预测出院时的功能结局，与10MWT、6MWT和BBS的出院分数强相关（R²=0.64-0.78）。将TPMs纳入机器学习模型显著提高了预测能力，6MWT的R²从0.30增至0.63，预测误差减少约25米。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study significantly enhances early prediction of functional recovery post-stroke by extracting Therapy Performance Metrics (TPMs) from clinical notes using machine learning. This suggests future potential for dynamic, real-time rehabilitation prediction and personalized intervention adjustments from routine clinical data.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（42例），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (42 participants) and is single-center, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Effects of an 8-week progressive neuro-athletic training program on goalkeeper movement performance: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An 8-week progressive neuro-athletic training (NAT) program, added to regular soccer training, significantly improved dynamic postural control (Y-Balance composite score: 2.74% within-group improvement, Hedges’ g = 1.07), change-of-direction performance (T-agility time decreased by 2.77%, Hedges’ g = -1.36), and countermovement jump flight time (Hedges’ g = 1.16) in 20 trained male soccer goalkeepers, compared to regular training alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，在常规训练基础上增加为期8周的神经运动训练（NAT）能显著改善足球守门员的动态姿势控制和变向表现。如果你在运动康复领域工作，考虑将NAT作为提高运动员核心运动表现的补充干预，尤其适用于需要快速反应和协调性的运动项目。
items.titleZh: 8周渐进式神经运动训练方案对守门员运动表现影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，在常规足球训练基础上，为期8周的渐进式神经运动训练（NAT）方案显著改善了20名训练有素的男性足球守门员的动态姿势控制（Y-平衡复合得分组内提升2.74%，Hedges’ g = 1.07）、变向表现（T-敏捷时间减少2.77%，Hedges’ g = -1.36）和反向跳跃滞空时间（Hedges’ g = 1.16）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that adding an 8-week neuro-athletic training (NAT) program to regular training significantly improves dynamic postural control and change-of-direction performance in soccer goalkeepers. If you work in sports rehabilitation, consider NAT as a supplementary intervention to enhance core athletic performance, especially for sports requiring rapid reactions and coordination.
items.limitation: 对照组未接受时间匹配的主动干预，可能高估了神经运动训练的独立效果。
items.limitationEn: The control group did not receive a time-matched active intervention, which may have overestimated the isolated effect of neuro-athletic training.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: 2027 Fee Schedule Analysis: Delayed MIPS Sunset Is Welcome News for PTs
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) finalized several Medicare Physician Fee Schedule policies for calendar year 2027, offering welcome news for physical therapists participating in quality reporting, and providing insight into CMS' preparedness to move to quality reporting and value-based care.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2027年医保医师费用表最终规则的分析报告，其中MIPS日落时间延迟的消息对物理治疗师来说是积极进展。你应关注这些政策变化，调整你的质量报告策略和价值护理模式，以优化报销。
items.titleZh: 2027 年费用表分析：MIPS 日落延迟对 PT 来说是好消息
items.summaryZh: 医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）最终确定了 2027 日历年度的几项医疗保险医师费用表政策，为参与质量报告的物理治疗师带来了好消息，并提供了 CMS 准备转向质量报告和价值型护理的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released an analysis of the 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule, with the delayed MIPS sunset being positive news for physical therapists. You should monitor these policy changes to adjust your quality reporting strategies and value-based care models to optimize reimbursement.

items.title: A machine learning-based assessment method for post-stroke dysfunction severity using the ICF-RS: a prospective study
items.summary: A machine learning framework developed using ICF-RS data from 2,812 stroke patients achieved a mean classification accuracy of 0.84 in fivefold cross-validation and 0.71 in two external validation cohorts for post-stroke dysfunction severity. The derived continuous severity score was negatively correlated with the Modified Barthel Index (r = -0.61).
items.curatedReason: 这个基于机器学习的模型能够将ICF-RS数据转化为中风后功能障碍的序数分类和连续严重度评分，有望支持个性化康复规划和更高效的资源分配。在临床实践中，可以考虑引入这类工具辅助标准化评估。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习的 ICF-RS 中风后功能障碍严重程度评估方法：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项基于2812名中风患者ICF-RS数据的机器学习框架，在五折交叉验证中实现了0.84的平均分类准确率，在两个外部验证队列中实现了0.71的准确率，用于评估中风后功能障碍的严重程度。导出的连续严重度评分与改良Barthel指数呈负相关（r = -0.61）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This machine learning-based model can convert ICF-RS data into ordinal classifications and continuous severity scores for post-stroke dysfunction, potentially supporting personalized rehabilitation planning and more efficient resource allocation. In clinical practice, consider incorporating such tools to aid standardized assessment.
items.limitation: 模型在外部验证队列中的准确性低于内部交叉验证，提示其泛化能力仍有提升空间。
items.limitationEn: The model's accuracy in external validation cohorts was lower than in internal cross-validation, suggesting room for improvement in generalizability.

items.title: Virtual Reality and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training in Gait and Balance Rehabilitation After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 15 RCTs (900 individuals) found that both Virtual Reality (VR) and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training (BWSTT) may improve gait and balance after stroke, with effects comparable to conventional rehabilitation, though evidence certainty is low to moderate.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实（VR）和体重支持跑步机训练（BWSTT）均可作为卒中后步态和平衡康复的辅助手段，且效果可能与传统康复相当。你可以考虑将这些技术整合到卒中患者的康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实与体重支持跑步机训练在卒中后步态和平衡康复中的应用：随机对照试验的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 15 项随机对照试验（900 名个体）的系统综述发现，虚拟现实（VR）和体重支持跑步机训练（BWSTT）均可能改善卒中后的步态和平衡，效果与传统康复相当，但证据确定性为中低等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both Virtual Reality (VR) and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training (BWSTT) can serve as adjuncts for gait and balance rehabilitation after stroke, with effects potentially comparable to conventional rehabilitation. Consider integrating these technologies into stroke patient recovery plans.
items.limitation: 由于临床和方法学异质性高，本系统综述仅进行定性合成，证据确定性为中低等。
items.limitationEn: Due to high clinical and methodological heterogeneity, this systematic review only performed qualitative synthesis, and the certainty of evidence is low to moderate.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Low-Cost Visual Art in Stroke Neurorehabilitation: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 papers explored low-cost visual art in stroke neurorehabilitation, finding it supported communication, self-expression, and improved quality of life, mood, self-efficacy, social connectedness, and fine motor/speech outcomes, though direct links to neuroplasticity remain limited.
items.curatedReason: 低成本视觉艺术干预可能在卒中患者的康复中发挥辅助作用，尤其在改善沟通、情绪、自我效能和精细运动方面，但目前仍需更多研究来明确其神经可塑性机制和临床实施指南。
items.titleZh: 卒中神经康复中的低成本视觉艺术：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入 42 篇论文，发现低成本视觉艺术在卒中神经康复中支持沟通和自我表达，并改善生活质量、情绪、自我效能、社交联系以及精细运动/言语结局，但与神经可塑性的直接关联仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Low-cost visual art interventions may serve as adjuncts in stroke rehabilitation, particularly for improving communication, mood, self-efficacy, and fine motor outcomes, though further research is needed to clarify neuroplasticity links and implementation guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入文献异质性高，且视觉艺术与神经可塑性直接关联的研究有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review with high heterogeneity among included studies, and direct research linking visual art to neuroplasticity is limited.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation
